units.zh: 卷八十七上 揚雄傳第五十七上
units.en: Book 87a—the fifty-seventh memoir, first part: Yang Xiong.
units.literal: Scroll 87, part one: Biography of Yang Xiong, number fifty-seven, part one.

units.zh: 揚雄字子雲，蜀郡成都人也。
units.en: Yang Xiong, courtesy name Ziyun, was a native of Chengdu in the Shu commandery.
units.literal: Yang Xiong, styled Ziyun, was a man of Chengdu in Shu Commandery.

units.zh: 其先出自有周伯僑者，以支庶初食采於晉之揚，因氏焉，不知伯僑周何別也。
units.en: His line descended from Bo Qiao of the Zhou royal house; a younger branch first held its fief at Yang in Jin and took that place name as their surname—Bo Qiao's exact relation within the Zhou kin is no longer known.
units.literal: His ancestor came from one Bo Qiao of the Zhou; as a collateral line he first received a food-fief at Yang in Jin, and from this took the surname; it is not known what branch of Zhou Bo Qiao was.

units.zh: 揚在河、汾之間，周衰而揚氏或稱侯，號曰揚侯。
units.en: Their fief lay between the Yellow and Fen rivers; as the Zhou waned the clan was ennobled as marquises of Yang.
units.literal: Yang lay between the He and Fen; when Zhou declined, the Yang clan was sometimes titled marquis, called the Marquis of Yang.

units.zh: 會晉六卿爭權、韓、魏、趙興而范中行、知伯弊。
units.en: Then came the struggle of the six ministerial houses of Jin: Han, Wei, and Zhao rose to power while the houses of Fan, Zhonghang, and Zhi were destroyed.
units.literal: It happened that Jin's six ministers struggled for power; Han, Wei, and Zhao rose while Fan, Zhonghang, and Zhi Bo were ruined.

units.zh: 當是時，逼揚侯，揚侯逃於楚巫山，因家焉。
units.en: Under that pressure the marquis of Yang fled to the Wu mountains of Chu and settled there.
units.literal: At this time they pressed the Marquis of Yang; the Marquis of Yang fled to Chu Mount Wu and thereupon made his home there.

units.zh: 楚漢之興也，揚氏溯江上，處巴江州。
units.en: When Chu and Han contended for the empire, the Yangs moved up the Yangzi and settled in the Ba river country.
units.literal: At the rise of Chu and Han, the Yang clan went upstream on the Yangzi and dwelt at Ba Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 而揚季官至廬江太守。
units.en: Yang Ji rose to be grand administrator of Lujiang.
units.literal: And Yang Ji reached office as Grand Administrator of Lujiang.

units.zh: 漢元鼎間避仇復溯江上，處岷山之陽曰郫，有田一廛，有宅一區，世世以農桑為業。
units.en: During Yuanding they fled a blood feud, moved again upriver, and settled south of Mount Min at Pi—one homestead, one plot of land—where for generations they lived by farming and silk.
units.literal: In Han's Yuanding period, fleeing feud they again went upstream on the Yangzi and dwelt south of Mount Min at Pi; they had one chan of fields and one plot of house; generation after generation they took farming and sericulture as their occupation.

units.zh: 自季至雄，五世而傳一子，故雄亡它揚於蜀。
units.en: From Ji to Xiong each generation had only a single male heir, so in Shu there were no other branches of the Yang clan.
units.literal: From Ji to Xiong, for five generations they transmitted one son each; therefore Xiong had no other Yangs in Shu.

units.zh: 雄少而好學，不為章句，訓詁通而已，博覽無所不見。
units.en: From boyhood he loved books but scorned pedantic glossing: he mastered glosses only far enough to grasp the sense, then read widely in every field.
units.literal: From youth Xiong loved learning; he did not do chapter-and-verse; glosses and explanations—understanding was enough; broadly reading, there was nothing he did not see.

units.zh: 為人簡易佚蕩，口吃不能劇談，默而好深湛之思，清靜亡為，少耆欲，不汲汲於富貴，不戚戚於貧賤，不修廉隅以徼名當世。
units.en: He was easygoing and unbuttoned, hampered by a stammer so that he spoke little, but his mind ran deep; he lived quietly, cared little for appetite or display, neither scrambled after rank nor brooded on poverty, and would not polish a reputation among his contemporaries.
units.literal: In person he was easy and simple, leisurely and unrestrained; he stammered and could not talk rapidly; silent, he loved deep and sunken thought; pure and quiet without action; few were his keen desires; he was not urgent about wealth and honor, not sorrowful about poverty and low status; he did not trim the corners of integrity to beg fame in the generation.

units.zh: 家產不過十金，乏無儋石之儲，晏如也。
units.en: His whole estate was worth less than ten pounds of gold, and he often lacked even a peck of grain in the jar—yet he remained unruffled.
units.literal: Household goods did not exceed ten jin of gold; he lacked even a dan or shi of stored grain; yet he was tranquil like so.

units.zh: 自有下度：非聖哲之書不好也；
units.en: He set his own standard: nothing pleased him but the writings of sages and wise men;
units.literal: He had his own lower measure: unless they were the writings of sages and wise men, he did not love them;

units.zh: 非其意，雖富貴不事也。
units.en: And what ran against his intent he would not do, even for wealth and rank.
units.literal: If it was not to his intent, though wealth and honor were offered, he would not serve.

units.zh: 顧嘗好辭賦。
units.en: All the while he loved belles lettres and fu poetry.
units.literal: Yet he ever loved rhapsodies and verse.

units.zh: 先是時，蜀有司馬相如，作賦甚弘麗溫雅，雄心壯之，每作賦，常擬之以為式。
units.en: Earlier, Shu had produced Sima Xiangru, whose fu were magnificent yet refined; Xiong admired him and took his style as the model for his own verse.
units.literal: Before this time Shu had Sima Xiangru; he made rhapsodies very grand, beautiful, warm, and elegant; Xiong's heart was stirred by them; whenever he made a rhapsody, he always modeled them taking them as pattern.

units.zh: 又怪屈原文過相如，至不容，作《離騷》，自投江而死，悲其文，讀之未嘗不流涕也。
units.en: He also marveled that Qu Yuan's gifts outshone even Xiangru's, yet the court would not tolerate him—so he wrote Encountering Sorrow and drowned himself in the river. Xiong mourned that work and wept whenever he read it.
units.literal: Also he marveled that Qu Yuan's pattern surpassed Xiangru's, yet reached to not being tolerated; he made Lisao and threw himself in the river and died; he pitied his text; reading it he never failed to shed tears.

units.zh: 以為君子得時則大行，不得時則龍蛇，遇不遇命也，何必湛身哉！
units.en: He held that when the times favor a gentleman he may act on a grand scale, and when they do not he may coil like a dragon—success or obscurity is Heaven's decree, and no man need destroy himself for it.
units.literal: He deemed that the gentleman, obtaining the time, then greatly acts; not obtaining the time, then is dragon or serpent; meeting or not meeting is fate—why must he drown his person!

units.zh: 乃作書，往往摭《離騷》文而反之，自岷山投諸江流以吊屈原，名曰《反離騷》；
units.en: So he composed a piece that took phrases from Encountering Sorrow and turned their sense, intending to cast it into the river from Mount Min as an offering to Qu Yuan; he titled it Contrary Lisao.
units.literal: Thereupon he made a writing, often plucking Lisao's text and reversing it, from Mount Min casting it to the river flow to mourn Qu Yuan; he called it Fan Lisao (Contrary Lisao);

units.zh: 又旁《離騷》作重一篇，名曰《廣騷》；
units.en: He also wrote a companion piece expanding on Lisao, called Broadening Sao.
units.literal: Also beside Lisao he made a doubled piece, called it Guang Sao (Broadening Sao);

units.zh: 又旁《惜誦》以下至《懷沙》一卷，名曰《畔牢愁》。
units.en: Another suite, from "Bitter Remembrance" through "Embracing the Sands," he entitled Sorrow in Captivity.
units.literal: Also, taking pieces from Xisong down through Huaisha into one scroll, he called it Panlao Chou.

units.zh: 《畔牢愁》、《廣騷》文多，不載，獨載《反離騷》，其辭曰：
units.en: Sorrow in Captivity and Broadening Sao are too long to quote here; only Contrary Lisao is given in full. It begins:
units.literal: Panlao Chou and Guang Sao's text was much; it is not recorded; only Fan Lisao is recorded; its words say:

units.zh: 有周氏之蟬嫣兮，或鼻祖於汾隅，靈宗初諜伯僑兮，流於末之揚侯。
units.en: The house of Zhou stretches in long descent: some say our forebear stood at Fen's shore; the spirit-line began with Bo Qiao and flowed on to the marquises of Yang.
units.literal: Ah, the house of Zhou in winding descent—some trace our first ancestor to Fen's bend; the sacred line opened with Bo Qiao, and ran down to the Marquis of Yang in later generations.

units.zh: 淑周楚之豐烈兮，超既離乎皇波，因江潭而水往托兮，欽吊楚之湘累。
units.en: I summon the high renown of Zhou and Chu, I have left the emperor's tide behind; borne on the streams I offer this lament for Qu Yuan, the exile of the Xiang.
units.literal: I take up the splendid deeds of Zhou and Chu, I have crossed the great royal wave; riding the river's current I send this pledge, to mourn the poet bound to Xiang's waters.

units.zh: 惟天軌之不辟兮，何純潔而離紛！
units.en: Heaven's course does not run true— why must unstained purity be tangled in turmoil?
units.literal: The track of Heaven is not straight— why must the wholly pure be torn by strife!

units.zh: 紛累以其淟涊兮，暗累以其繽紛。
units.en: Muddy troubles rise in reeking swirls, and murk in motley clouds hides the light.
units.literal: Turbid troubles well up thick and foul, dim veils of dust obscure the bloom.

units.zh: 漢十世之陽朔兮，招搖紀於周正，正皇天之清則兮，度后土之方貞。
units.en: In the tenth age of Han, under Yangshuo's star, in the month the Zhou calendar fixed— I take Heaven's bright standard as my rule, I pace the square truth of the soil below.
units.literal: In Han's tenth reign, the year-star in Yangshuo, the month set by Zhou's calendar— I align with bright Heaven's clear rule, I measure the square steadfastness of earth.

units.zh: 圖累承彼洪族兮，又覽累之昌辭，帶鉤矩而佩衡兮，履欃槍以為綦。
units.en: I share that noble blood, I ponder its splendid phrases; square and plumb hang at my belt, I walk the comet's path as laced-up shoes.
units.literal: I, too, inherit that mighty clan, I read again its glorious words; girdle-square and arm-rule hang at my side, I tread the comet's trail as my patterned shoe.

units.zh: 素初貯厥麗服兮，何文肆而質Ε！
units.en: From the ancient wardrobe I take those gorgeous gowns— why parade such ornament when the inner substance falls short?
units.literal: From the primal store I draw those splendid robes— why such display of pattern when the substance is wanting!

units.zh: 資娵、娃炎珍鬄兮，鬻九戎而索賴。
units.en: They barter Ju and Wa beauties for trinkets, they peddle the nine Yi for a meal.
units.literal: They prize Ju and Wa's curled locks, they hawk the nine outer tribes for grain.

units.zh: 鳳皇翔於蓬陼兮，豈駕鵝之能捷！
units.en: The phoenix wheels above the sacred isle— could a barnyard goose outfly that wing?
units.literal: The phoenix soars over Penglai's height— how could a barnyard goose keep pace!

units.zh: 騁驊騮以曲艱兮，驢騾連蹇而齊足。
units.en: The thoroughbred strains on crooked lanes; mules and donkeys hobble abreast.
units.literal: Bay horses strain on twisting tracks, while mules and asses stumble side by side.

units.zh: 枳棘之榛榛兮，蝯□穴擬而不敢下，靈修既信椒、蘭之唼佞兮，吾累忽焉而不蚤睹？
units.en: Zizhi grows dense; apes peer from dens and dare not drop; the king believed the sweet talk of pepper and orchid— should I not have seen it sooner?
units.literal: Thorns and brambles grow thick— apes peer from their holes and dare not descend; the fair lord trusted pepper and orchid's flattery— how could I not have seen it long before?

units.zh: 衿芰茄之綠衣兮，被夫容之硃裳，芳酷烈而莫聞兮，不如襞而幽之離房。
units.en: Lotus coat and crimson skirt— fierce perfume none will smell; better fold them in the inner room alone.
units.literal: Green coat of water-caltrop, red skirt of lotus bloom— fragrance fierce yet none perceive; better fold them away in the lonely chamber.

units.zh: 閨中容競淖約兮，相態以麗佳，知眾ㄥ之嫉妒兮，何必揚累之蛾眉？
units.en: In the inner chambers each vies in slender grace; knowing how the many grudge beauty— why must I arch these moth eyebrows still higher?
units.literal: Within the boudoir rivals vie in grace, each striking a lovelier pose; knowing how the crowd envies— why need I raise these moth brows higher?

units.zh: 懿神龍之淵潛，俟慶雲而將舉，亡春風之被離兮，孰焉知龍之所處？
units.en: The holy dragon lurks in the pool, waiting for lucky clouds before it climbs; without spring wind to lift him, who can tell where the dragon lies?
units.literal: The divine dragon hides in the deep, waiting for auspicious cloud to rise; without spring wind's spreading touch, who knows where the dragon abides?

units.zh: 愍吾累之眾芬兮，揚燁燁之芳苓，遭季夏之凝霜兮，慶夭悴而喪榮。
units.en: I mourn my many perfumes, I lift bright calamus and orchid; yet summer's killing frost strikes— the tender bloom is blasted and its honor lost.
units.literal: I pity my many fragrances, I raise blazing calamus and sweet iris; but late summer's killing frost falls— the young glory withers and its splendor dies.

units.zh: 橫江、湘以南水往兮，雲走乎彼蒼吾，馳江潭之泛溢兮，將折衷乎重華。
units.en: South of the Yangzi and Xiang I ride the flood; clouds race under the blue vault; I speed the river's swells to seek judgment from Shun the double-pupiled.
units.literal: I cross south of the Yangzi and Xiang with the flowing water; clouds race to that azure height; I gallop the river pools where they overflow; I shall seek the mean with Chonghua.

units.zh: 舒中情之煩或兮，恐重華之不累與，陵陽侯之素波兮，豈吾累之獨見許？
units.en: I pour out my troubled heart, yet fear Shun will not heed me; I ride the pale waves of the river god— would he single me out for trust?
units.literal: I unfold the heart's troubled heat; I fear Chonghua will not join with me; I mount Lord Yang's pale waves— could I alone be the one he favors?

units.zh: 精瓊靡與秋菊兮，將以延夫天年；
units.en: Fine elixir and autumn chrysanthemum were meant to lengthen your years;
units.literal: Refined jade-gruel and autumn chrysanthemum— I meant thereby to lengthen heaven-allotted years;

units.zh: 臨汩羅而自隕兮，恐日薄於西山。
units.en: You stood by the Miluo and leapt to your death— the sun was already sinking toward the western hill.
units.literal: You faced the Miluo and cast yourself down; I fear the sun is setting toward the western hills.

units.zh: 解扶桑之總轡兮，縱令之遂奔馳，鸞皇騰而不屬兮，豈獨飛廉與雲師！
units.en: You slipped the reins at the eastern tree and let the team bolt; the phoenix car rises and none can follow— not wind-god nor cloud-driver alone.
units.literal: You loosed Fusang's gathered reins and let them race free; phoenix mounts soar and will not follow— is it only Feilian and the cloud-master?

units.zh: 卷薜芷與若蕙兮，臨湘淵而投之；
units.en: I bundle river iris and sweet rush and cast them into the Xiang pool;
units.literal: I roll up elseland and tender orchid, I come to the Xiang abyss and cast them in;

units.zh: 棍申椒與菌桂兮，赴江湖而漚之。
units.en: I tie pepper and cassia and sink them in the great streams to steep their virtue.
units.literal: I bundle Shen pepper and cinnamon bark, I hurl them to the rivers and lakes to steep them.

units.zh: 費椒稰以要神兮，又勤索彼瓊茅，違靈氛而不從兮，反湛身於江皋！
units.en: You squandered grain to move the gods, you pried with reed stalks for omens; you spurned Ling Fen's counsel and would not follow— and threw your life into the shallows!
units.literal: You spent peppered millet to summon the spirits, you toiled to seek that jade-thatched divination; you turned from Ling Fen's counsel and would not follow— then drowned yourself on the river bank!

units.zh: 累既攀夫傅說兮，奚不信而遂行？
units.en: Once you had climbed to Fu Yue in dream— why not trust the sign and press on?
units.literal: You had already climbed to Fu Yue— why not trust and go straight on?

units.zh: 徒恐鷤圭□之將鳴兮，顧先百草為不芳！
units.en: I fear the cuckoo's cry is near— every fragrant plant will wither before you wake!
units.literal: I only fear the cuckoo will soon cry— and every herb will lose its scent before you know it!

units.zh: 初累棄彼虙妃兮，更思瑤台之逸女，抨雄鴆以作媒兮，何百離而曾不一耦！
units.en: First you cast off the river goddess, then you pined for the girl on the jade tower; you took the osprey as matchmaker— yet never won a single union through a hundred griefs!
units.literal: At first you spurned Lady Fu; then you longed for the maid on the jade terrace; you sent the male osprey as go-between— why a hundred partings and never one match!

units.zh: 乘雲蜺之旖柅兮，，望崑崙以樛流，覽四荒而顧懷兮，奚必雲女彼高丘？
units.en: I ride the rainbow's curve and gaze toward winding Kunlun; I scan the world's four quarters— need I seek that goddess on the high hill?
units.literal: Riding the rainbow's slow sway, I gaze on Kunlun's winding height; I scan the four wastes and look back with longing— must I wed that girl on the high mound?

units.zh: 既亡鸞車之幽藹兮，駕八龍之委蛇？
units.en: With no phoenix car veiled in mist— shall I harness eight dragons in serried line?
units.literal: Since there is no phoenix coach in dim splendor— shall I yoke eight dragons in long winding train?

units.zh: 臨江瀕而掩涕兮，何有《九招》與《九歌》？
units.en: You wept by the river's edge— what use then were the Nine Shao and the Nine Songs?
units.literal: You stood by the river's brink and hid your tears— where then were the Nine Shao and the Nine Songs?

units.zh: 夫聖哲之遭兮，固時命之所有；
units.en: For the wise man in his fortune— the times and Heaven's decree hold all;
units.literal: For sage and wise man in their lot— it is ever fate and season that rule;

units.zh: 雖增欷以於邑兮，吾恐靈修之不累改。
units.en: Though I sigh till my throat aches— I fear the king will never mend his ways.
units.literal: Though I sigh and choke with grief— I fear the Fair One will not change at last.

units.zh: 昔仲尼之去魯兮，婓□遲遲而周邁，終回復於舊都兮，何必湘淵與濤瀨！
units.en: When Confucius left Lu he lingered and wandered the circuit of states, yet at last he came home to his city— he did not need the Xiang's depths and boiling rapids!
units.literal: Of old when Zhongni left Lu— he faltered long and circled the realm; in the end he returned to the old capital— why must it be the Xiang abyss and rushing shoals!

units.zh: 混漁父之餔歠兮，潔沐浴之振衣，棄由、聃之所珍兮，□庶彭鹹之所遺！
units.en: Share the fisherman's coarse fare, then bathe and shake out your robe; leave what Xu You and Laozi held dear—take up the path Peng Xian left behind!
units.literal: Mingle with the fisherman's soup and drink; bathe clean and shake out your robe; cast aside what Xu You and Laozi treasured—follow the way Peng Xian left behind!

units.zh: 孝成帝時，客有薦雄文似相如者，上方郊祠甘泉泰畤、汾陰后土，以求繼嗣，召雄待詔承明之庭。
units.en: Under Emperor Cheng a visitor praised Xiong's prose as rivaling Sima Xiangru's. The emperor was preparing suburban sacrifices at the Grand Altar of Sweet Springs and at the earth shrine of Fenyin to win a successor, and summoned Xiong as expectant scholar in the Chenming hall.
units.literal: In Emperor Cheng's time a guest recommended Xiong's writings as resembling Xiangru's; the sovereign was about to perform suburban sacrifice at Sweet Springs' Grand Altar and at Fenyin to Earth, seeking an heir; he summoned Xiong to await edicts in the Chenming courtyard.

units.zh: 正月，從上甘泉，還奏《甘泉賦》以風。
units.en: In the first month he accompanied the court to Sweet Springs and afterward presented his Sweet Springs Rhapsody as veiled criticism.
units.literal: In the first month he followed the sovereign to Sweet Springs; on return he presented the Sweet Springs Rhapsody as remonstrance.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: The text reads:
units.literal: Its words say:

units.zh: 惟漢十世，將郊上玄，定泰畤，雍神休，尊明號，同符三皇，錄功五帝，恤胤錫羨，拓跡開統。
units.en: In the tenth reign of Han the emperor will sacrifice to High Heaven, establish the Grand Altar, draw down divine favor, proclaim a glorious title, align his merit with the Three Sovereigns and the Five Thearchs, pity the heir and shower blessing, and extend the founding enterprise.
units.literal: Han's tenth age will sacrifice to High Dark, fix the Grand Altar, harmonize the god's blessing, honor the bright title, match the talismans of the Three Augusts, record the Five Thearchs' deeds, pity the heir and grant abundance, widen the trace and open the line.

units.zh: 於是乃命群僚，歷吉日，協靈辰，星陳而天行。
units.en: Then he charges his ministers, picks a lucky day and a propitious hour, and the host moves like stars across the sky.
units.literal: Thereupon he charges the host of officials, chooses an auspicious day, aligns the spirit hour— stars deployed, Heaven itself moves.

units.zh: 詔招搖與泰陰兮，伏鉤陳使當兵，屬堪輿以壁壘兮，梢夔、□而抶□狂。
units.en: He calls the Dipper and the northern yin, sets the Curved Array to guard the line, rings the camp with the geomancer's chart, and drives off demons with blows.
units.literal: He summons the Dipper and Grand Yin, posts the Curved Array to hold the spears, binds the diviner's chart into ramparts, strikes the thunder spirits and flogs the mad.

units.zh: 八神奔而警蹕兮，振殷轔而軍裝，蚩尤之倫帶干將而秉玉戚兮，飛蒙茸而走陸梁。
units.en: Eight gods race ahead while outriders clear the road; harnesses clang in war array; Chiyou's train gird on long swords and jade halberds, plumes streaming as they march with swagger.
units.literal: The eight spirits run while guards clear the way; bronze chariots thunder in battle dress; Chiyou's like wear Gan blades and grasp jade axes; plumes flutter as they stride in martial pride.

units.zh: 齊總總撙撙，其相膠葛兮，□駭雲訊，奮以方攘；
units.en: They crowd in dense confusion, tangled like twisted rope; banners of cloud rear and wheel as the host sweeps the field.
units.literal: Massed thick and pressed tight, tangled each with each; cloud banners startle and flare, they surge to clear the square.

units.zh: 駢羅列布，鱗以雜沓兮，柴□參差，魚頡而鳥□行；
units.en: They stand paired in rows like layered scales; staggered like fish and birds in flight.
units.literal: Rank on rank they spread like scales in layers; staggered heights, fish dive and birds wheel in file.

units.zh: 翕赫□霍，霧集蒙合兮，半散照爛，粲以成章。
units.en: Flame and lightning merge; mist rolls and closes; then light scatters into jeweled patterns.
units.literal: Sudden blaze and flashing light, fog gathers and merges; then half-scattered brilliance breaks into patterned glory.

units.zh: 於是乘輿乃登夫鳳皇兮翳華芝，駟蒼螭兮六素□，蠖略蕤綏，漓乎幓絲麗。
units.en: The chariot mounts the phoenix canopy veined with magic fungus; four azure dragons pull six pale horses; gemmed reins trail, colored pennons stream in the wind.
units.literal: Then the imperial car mounts the phoenix, shaded by splendid fungus; four green dragons draw six white horses; reins trail with tassel gems, silken streamers flutter bright.

units.zh: 帥爾陰閉，□然陽開，騰清霄而軼浮景兮，夫何□旐郅偈之旖□也！
units.en: Shadows close, then light bursts forth; the car springs through azure heaven past the drifting sun— how the great banners dip and stream!
units.literal: Now shadow closes, now radiance opens; it leaps through clear sky past the floating gleam— how those banners dip and stream on high!

units.zh: 流星□以電燭兮，鹹翠蓋而鸞旗。
units.en: Shooting stars flash like lightning; riders dip the jade-green awning and phoenix standards.
units.literal: Meteors streak like lightning; all lower the kingfisher canopy and phoenix flags.

units.zh: 敦萬騎於中營兮，方玉車之千乘。
units.en: Ten thousand riders mass at the central camp; jade-decked chariots stand in squares a thousand strong.
units.literal: He masses ten thousand horse in the middle camp; jade chariots stand in squares of a thousand teams.

units.zh: 聲駍隱以陸離兮，輕先疾雷而馺遺風。
units.en: The rumble spreads vast and broken; the train outraces thunder and leaves the gale astern.
units.literal: The sound rolls deep and scattered; they outrun the thunderclap and leave the whirlwind behind.

units.zh: 陵高衍之□嵷兮，超紆譎之清澄。
units.en: They climb the long slope's rugged crest; they ford the winding shallows' limpid flow.
units.literal: They climb the high slope's jagged ridge; they cross the winding ford's clear depths.

units.zh: 登椽欒而□天門兮，馳閶闔而入凌兢。
units.en: They mount the sky ladder toward the celestial gate; they race through the gate of heaven and enter the dizzying height.
units.literal: They mount the gallery ladder toward Heaven's gate; they gallop through the cosmic tower and enter the trembling height.

units.zh: 是時未輳夫甘泉也，乃望通天之繹繹。
units.en: Before they reached Sweet Springs they saw the tower that threads the sky stretch endlessly on.
units.literal: They had not yet reached Sweet Springs, yet already they saw the sky-piercing height stretch on without end.

units.zh: 下陰潛以慘凜兮，上洪紛而相錯；
units.en: Below spreads shadow and biting cold; above, great billows tangle and cross.
units.literal: Below lies gloom and bitter chill; above, vast billows cross and tangle.

units.zh: 直嶢嶢以造天兮，厥高慶而不可乎疆度。
units.en: Peak thrusts on peak straight toward heaven; its height defeats every measure.
units.literal: Straight it thrusts, peak on peak, to touch the sky; its height is so vast no boundary can be measured.

units.zh: 平原唐其壇曼兮，列新雉於林薄；
units.en: The plain rolls wide and far; new-planted thickets line the forest's edge.
units.literal: The plain spreads wide and rolling; new pheasant cry among the thin woods.

units.zh: 攢並閭與□{艸舌}兮，紛被麗其亡鄂。
units.en: Torreya and fragrant herbs crowd thick; lush growth runs on without a bound.
units.literal: They cluster the torreya and tongue-leaf plant; luxuriant growth knows no border.

units.zh: 崇丘陵之□□兮，深溝嶔巖而為谷；
units.en: They pile hills in towering stairs; they carve gorges steep as cliffs into valleys.
units.literal: They raise hill on hill in towering steps; they cut deep gorges sheer as cliffs to make valleys.

units.zh: □離宮般以相燭兮，封巒石關施靡乎延屬。
units.en: Detached palaces flash light to each other; Stone Pass and Seal Peak run on in endless line.
units.literal: Detached palaces glow one upon another; Stone Pass and Seal Peak link on in endless range.

units.zh: 於是大夏雲譎波詭，□而成觀，仰撟首以高視兮，目冥□而亡見。
units.en: Then the great hall shifts like clouds and surging waves, a sight to marvel at; they tilt their heads until their eyes dim in the gloom.
units.literal: Then the great hall shifts like cloud and wave, shaping a spectacle; they crane their necks to gaze on high till sight fails in the dark.

units.zh: 正瀏濫以弘惝兮，指東西之漫漫，徒回回以徨徨兮，魂固眇眇而昏亂。
units.en: They steady their gaze on the endless reach; east and west run on without limit; they turn and wander; the spirit floats lost and dazed.
units.literal: They steady the flood gaze on boundless space; east and west stretch endlessly; they wheel and wander; the soul drifts faint and confused.

units.zh: 據軨軒而周流兮，忽□夾軋而亡垠。
units.en: They lean from the carved rail and wheel about; suddenly the narrow pass leaves no margin.
units.literal: They lean from the carved bar and circle round; suddenly the narrow squeeze leaves no margin.

units.zh: 翠玉樹之青蔥兮，壁馬犀之瞵□。
units.en: Jade trees stand green and fresh; horses of jade and rhinoceros shine in ranks.
units.literal: Emerald trees of jade stand fresh and green; wall horses and rhinoceros gleam in rows.

units.zh: 金人仡仡其承鐘□兮，嵌巖巖其龍鱗，揚光曜之燎燭兮，乘景炎之□□，配帝居之縣圃兮，像泰壹之威神。
units.en: Bronze giants shoulder the bells, scaled like dragons on a cliff; torches blaze; they ride rolling fire; they match the Hanging Garden of the celestial court; they image the awesome god Grand Unity.
units.literal: Bronze giants tall as mountains shoulder the bell racks; clifflike scales like dragons; they raise torch-bright gleam; they ride billowing flame; they match the Hanging Garden of the emperor's abode; they image Grand Unity's awesome god.

units.zh: 洪台掘其獨出兮，□北極之□，列宿乃施於上榮兮，日月才經於□，雷鬱律而巖突兮，電倏忽於牆籓。
units.en: The great tower shoots upward alone; it brushes the pole star; constellations deck its crest; sun and moon cross its beams; thunder rolls in its recesses; lightning darts along its parapets.
units.literal: The great tower juts alone; it brushes the pole star; constellations spread along its upper ridge; sun and moon pass its eaves; thunder booms in its vaults; lightning flickers along its walls.

units.zh: 鬼魅不能自還兮，半長途而下顛。
units.en: Ghosts and goblins cannot find their way back; halfway up the long climb they tumble headlong.
units.literal: Ghosts and sprites cannot turn back; halfway along the climb they tumble down.

units.zh: 歷倒景而絕飛梁兮，浮蔑蠓而撇天。
units.en: They cross the bridge of light and span the flying arch; they drift like midges skimming heaven.
units.literal: They cross the inverted gleam and span the flying bridge; they float like gnats brushing the sky.

units.zh: 左□槍右玄冥兮，前□闕後應門；
units.en: Comet left, Dark North right; sacred towers before, the answering gate behind;
units.literal: Spear-star left, Dark North right; divine towers ahead, the answering gate behind;

units.zh: 陰西海與幽都兮，湧醴汩以生川。
units.en: They veil the western sea and the land of shades; sweet springs bubble up and turn to rivers.
units.literal: They shade the western sea and the dark north; sweet springs gush and become streams.

units.zh: 蛟龍連蜷於東崖兮，白虎敦圉虖崑崙。
units.en: Dragons coil along the eastern cliff; the white tiger stands sentry at Kunlun.
units.literal: Coiled dragons cling to the eastern cliff; the white tiger guards round Kunlun.

units.zh: 覽樛流於高光兮，溶方皇於西清。
units.en: They watch the winding current from the terrace of light; broad pennons gather in the western court.
units.literal: They view the winding flow from the height of light; they merge broad banners in the western court.

units.zh: 前殿崔巍兮，和氏瓏玲，炕浮柱之飛榱兮，神莫莫而扶傾，閌閬閬其寥廓兮，似紫宮之崢嶸。
units.en: The forward hall rises sheer; He-family jade chimes tinkle; flying rafters spring from floating posts; unseen spirits steady the leaning pile; the gate opens on immensity like the Purple Palace in the sky.
units.literal: The front hall towers sheer; He jewels tinkle; rafters leap from floating pillars; gods silently steady the leaning mass; the gate vaults vast as the void; it seems the Purple Palace's crags.

units.zh: 駢交錯而曼衍兮，□妥□虖其相嬰。
units.en: Beams interlace in endless weave; carved brackets knit and cling.
units.literal: Beams cross and weave in endless mesh; carved brackets interlace and cling.

units.zh: 乘雲閣而上下兮，紛蒙籠以□成。
units.en: They ride the cloud pavilion up and down; misty curtains fold into shape.
units.literal: They mount the cloud gallery up and down; misty veils fold and form.

units.zh: 曳紅采之流離兮，颺翠氣之冤延。
units.en: They trail shimmering red silk; they raise long coils of green mist.
units.literal: They trail red silks that shimmer; they lift green vapor long and winding.

units.zh: 襲□室與傾宮兮，若登高妙遠，肅乎臨淵。
units.en: They pass halls like tilted jade towers; it feels like climbing high to gaze afar, solemn as standing on a precipice.
units.literal: They enter chambers like those of jade and tilted towers; it is like climbing high to scan the distance, solemn as standing on a brink.

units.zh: 回飆肆其碭駭兮，翍桂椒，郁栘楊。
units.en: The whirlwind rises with a shock; it strips cassia and pepper, bends the supple willows.
units.literal: Whirlwind rises with a shock; it strips cassia and pepper, bends the shifting poplars.

units.zh: 香芬茀以窮隆兮，擊薄櫨而將榮。
units.en: Perfume floods the high vault; it strikes the lattice and climbs toward the rafters.
units.literal: Fragrance billows to the highest vault; it strikes the thin lattice and climbs toward bloom.

units.zh: 薌□肸以掍根兮，聲駍隱而歷鐘，排玉戶而揚金舖兮，發蘭惠與穹窮。
units.en: Incense seeps to the deepest root; the rumble rolls past the bells; jade doors swing wide and golden knockers lift; orchid fragrance floods the endless hall.
units.literal: Incense spreads and sinks to the roots; the sound rolls deep and passes the bells; they push the jade doors and lift the golden knockers; orchid scent fills the boundless hall.

units.zh: 惟弸彋其拂汩兮，稍暗暗而靚深。
units.en: Vast winds sweep and swirl; little by little all grows dim and sinks into depth.
units.literal: Only the vast wind sweeps and swirls; gradually dim, dim, it grows still and deep.

units.zh: 陰陽清濁穆羽相和兮，若夔、牙之調琴。
units.en: Clear and turbid, high and low notes answer one another like Kui and Boya tuning a flawless lute.
units.literal: Yin and yang, clear and muddy, palace and feather tones blend— as Kui and Boya tuned the zither.

units.zh: 般、倕棄其剞厥兮，王爾投其鉤繩。
units.en: Ban and Chui cast aside their adze and chisel; Wang Er casts aside his hook and line.
units.literal: Ban and Chui cast aside their adze and chisel; Master Er casts aside hook and line.

units.zh: 雖方征僑與偓佺兮，猶彷彿其若夢。
units.en: Even immortal companions seemed phantoms; the whole sight floated like a dream.
units.literal: Though Fangqing and Wozhuan were there— still it all seemed only a drifting dream.

units.zh: 於是事變物化，目駭耳回，蓋天子穆然珍台閒館璇題玉英□蜎蠖濩之中，惟夫所以澄心清魂，儲精垂思，感動天地，逆釐三神者。
units.en: Things shifted and the senses reeled; the emperor sat withdrawn in jade-decked halls, purifying mind and soul, gathering spirit in meditation, to move Heaven and earth and draw down the favor of the Three Powers.
units.literal: Then affairs shifted and things transformed; eyes started, ears spun— for the Son of Heaven, in solemn quiet, in terraces and lodges of jade boss and jade bloom, coiled in stillness— this was how he clarified heart and purified soul, stored essence and let thought descend, to move Heaven and earth and welcome blessing from the Three Powers.

units.zh: 乃搜逑索耦皋、伊之徒，冠倫魁能，函甘棠之惠，挾東征之意，相與齊乎陽靈之宮。
units.en: He gathered men worthy to stand beside Gao and Yi, the best of their generation, mindful of old kindness and eastern expeditions, and together they entered the Yang Spirit shrine.
units.literal: Then he sought pairs matched like Gao and Yi, crowning the foremost and able, bearing the kindness of the sweet pear, carrying the mind of the eastern campaign; together they aligned themselves at the Palace of the Yang Spirit.

units.zh: 靡薜荔而為席兮，折瓊技以為芳，吸清雲之流瑕兮，飲若木之露英，集虖禮神之囿，登乎頌祇之堂。
units.en: They spread rushes for a seat and broke jade sprigs for incense; they drew pure mist and drank immortal dew; they entered the sacred park and the hall of praise to the earth.
units.literal: They spread elseland for mat, broke jade branches for fragrance; they breathed the clear cloud's lingering haze, drank the dew-bright blooms of the ruo tree; they gathered in the park where rites honor the gods, mounted the hall that hymns the earth lord.

units.zh: 建光耀之長旓兮，昭華覆之威威，攀璇璣而下視兮，行遊目乎三危，陳眾車於東坑兮，肆玉釱而下馳，漂龍淵而還九垠兮，窺地底而上回。
units.en: Long streamers of light rose; jeweled canopies spread wide; from on high they gazed toward Sanwei; chariots massed in the eastern hollow then charged with loosened reins; they circled the sacred pool and scanned the nine regions, then swept back toward the sky.
units.literal: They raised long banners of blazing light, spread glorious canopies august and wide; from the turning jade Sieve they looked down, let the roaming eye reach Mount Sanwei; they ranged the many chariots in the eastern pit, loosed jade curb-bands and galloped down; they drifted the Dragon Pool and circled the nine bounds, peeped to earth's floor and swept upward again.

units.zh: 風傱□而扶轄兮，鸞鳳紛其御蕤，梁弱水之濎濴兮，躡不周之逶蛇，想西王母欣然而上壽兮，屏玉女而卻虙妃。
units.en: Wind steadied the wheels; phoenix attendants flocked; they crossed the weak stream and trod the winding crest of Buzhou; they imagined the Queen Mother of the West offering the cup of long life— while jade girls and river goddesses were waved away.
units.literal: Wind rushed to steady the axle; phoenixes thronged with fluttering plumes; they crossed the weak water's deep swirl, trod the winding snake-path of Mount Buzhou; they thought how Queen Mother of the West would joyfully toast long life— they screened the jade maid and sent back Lady Fu.

units.zh: 玉女無所眺其清盧兮，虙妃曾不得施其蛾眉。
units.en: The jade maid might not flash her bright eyes; the river goddess might not raise her painted brows.
units.literal: The jade maid had nowhere to flash her clear glance; Lady Fu could not arch her moth brows.

units.zh: 方攬道德之精剛兮，侔神明與之為資。
units.en: He embraces the adamantine core of the Way; he makes the spirits his companions and support.
units.literal: Now he embraces the firm essence of the Way and Power; he matches the bright spirits and takes them as his aides.

units.zh: 於是欽祡宗祈。
units.en: Then came the solemn winter sacrifice to the royal ancestor.
units.literal: Thereupon he performs the winter offering and prays to the ancestor.

units.zh: 燎熏皇天，招繇泰壹。
units.en: The offering flame rises to High Heaven; Grand Unity is summoned to approach.
units.literal: Torch-smoke rises to august Heaven; he beckons and leads Grand Unity.

units.zh: 舉洪頤，樹靈旗。
units.en: He lifts the great jaw-shaped shield and raises the sacred banners.
units.literal: He raises the great chin-shield, plants the spirit flags.

units.zh: 樵蒸□昆上，配藜四施，東燭倉海，西耀流沙，北爌幽都，南煬丹崖。
units.en: Piled fuel sends flame toward the sky; light shoots east to the sea, west to the deserts, north to the shadowed pole, south to the vermilion cliffs.
units.literal: Kindling piled high climbs skyward; torches blaze to the four quarters— east lights the azure sea, west gleams over shifting sands, north flares to the dark north, south burns to the red cliffs.

units.zh: 玄瓚觩，秬鬯泔淡，肸向豐融，懿懿芬芬。
units.en: The dark sacrificial ladle gleams; black millet wine pours clear; fragrance spreads rich and full.
units.literal: Dark ladle with curled horn, black millet ale clear and still, spreads inward in rich fusion, sweet and thick on every side.

units.zh: 炎感黃龍兮，熛訛碩麟，選巫咸兮叫帝閽，開天庭兮延群神。
units.en: Fire moves the yellow dragon; prodigies blaze; Wu Xian calls at Heaven's gate; the court of heaven opens and the gods descend.
units.literal: Flame stirs the yellow dragon; blazing omens, huge unicorns; he chooses Wu Xian to call at Heaven's gate; opens the celestial court and draws down the host of gods.

units.zh: 儐暗藹兮降清壇，瑞穰穰兮委如山。
units.en: Shadowy ministers throng down to the pure altar; lucky grain heaps like a hill.
units.literal: The attendants dim and thick descend the pure altar; auspicious grain piles mountain-high.

units.zh: 於是事畢功弘，回車而歸，度三巒兮偈棠梨。
units.en: When the rite was finished they wheeled for home, crossed the triple ridges, and rested at Tangli.
units.literal: Then the work was done and merit great; they turned the chariots homeward, passed the triple peaks, halted at Tang pear.

units.zh: 天閫決兮地垠開，八荒協兮萬國諧。
units.en: The celestial gate swings open; the rim of earth unfolds; the eight wastes are in harmony; all kingdoms join the song.
units.literal: Heaven's gate opens wide; earth's margin spreads; the eight wilds accord; the myriad states are at peace.

units.zh: 登長平兮雷鼓磕，天聲趣兮勇士厲，雲飛揚兮雨滂沛，於胥德兮麗萬世。
units.en: On Changping the war drums thunder like heaven's voice; clouds lift, rain sweeps down in torrents— O virtue to shine through endless ages!
units.literal: They mount Changping where thunder drums boom; Heaven's voice hastens and warriors bristle; clouds fly and rain pours in flood— ah, such virtue, glorious for ten thousand ages!

units.zh: 亂曰：崇崇圜丘，隆隱天兮，登降峛崺，單埢坦兮。
units.en: Envoi: The round altar towers, lost in the sky; slopes rise and fall, then level on the plain.
units.literal: Envoi: Lofty the round mound, hidden in heaven; rising and falling, steep slopes, level on the plain.

units.zh: 增宮□差，駢嵯峨兮，嶺□菅嶙峋，洞亡崖兮。
units.en: Tier on tier the palaces climb; peaks and crags link on; gorges open without end.
units.literal: Added halls stagger layer on layer, peak on lofty peak; ridge on ridge, jagged rocks, caverns without shore.

units.zh: 上天之縡，杳旭卉兮，聖皇穆穆，信厥對兮。
units.en: Heaven's binding thread runs faint and high; the holy emperor, grave and still, truly answers its charge.
units.literal: The cord of High Heaven stretches faint and far; the sage emperor, solemn and still, truly answers Heaven.

units.zh: 徠祗效禋，神所依兮，徘徊招搖，靈遲□兮。
units.en: Come, spirits, accept the sacrifice— here the gods dwell; the Dipper turns; the bright spirits tarry.
units.literal: Come, spirits, accept the pure offering— the gods rely on you; the Dipper wheels; the spirits linger long.

units.zh: 輝光炫耀，隆厥福兮，子子孫孫，長亡極兮。
units.en: Glory blazes; blessing piles high; sons and grandsons without end.
units.literal: Radiance dazzles; blessing mounts high; sons and sons, grandsons and grandsons— endless without limit.

units.zh: 甘泉本因秦離宮，既奢泰，而武帝復增通天、高光、迎風。
units.en: Sweet Springs was first a Qin summer palace; already lavish, Emperor Wu added the Access to Heaven, Height of Light, and Wind-Meeting towers.
units.literal: Sweet Springs began as a Qin detached palace; already extravagant, Emperor Wu added Access to Heaven, Height of Light, and Wind-Meeting.

units.zh: 宮外近則洪崖、旁皇、儲胥、弩阹，遠則石關、封巒、枝鵲、露寒、棠梨、師得，遊觀屈奇瑰瑋，非木摩而不雕，牆塗而不畫，周宣所考，般庚所遷，夏卑宮室，唐、虞棌椽三等之制也。
units.en: Nearby stood Hongya, Panhuang, and the rest; farther off Stone Pass, Seal Peak, and other lodges— marvels of touring architecture, yet meant to recall King Xuan's scrutiny, Pan Geng's migration, Xia's humble halls, and the three grades of unadorned rafters of Tang and Yu.
units.literal: Near the palace lay Hongya, Panhuang, Chuxu, Nuqu; farther stood Stone Pass, Seal Peak, Branch Magpie, Cold Dew, Tang Pear, Shide— touring sights strange and grand, not carved where wood was not to be carved, not painted where plaster was not to be painted— such was the restraint King Xuan reviewed, such the move Pan Geng praised, such the low halls of Xia, such the unplaned rafters of three grades in Tang and Yu.

units.zh: 且其為已久矣，非成帝所造，欲諫則非時，欲默則不能已，故遂推而隆之，乃上比於帝室紫宮，若曰此非人力之所為，黨鬼神可也。
units.en: The complex was old, not Cheng's creation— ill-timed to attack, impossible to ignore— so Xiong praised it as rival to the celestial Purple Palace, hinting it was beyond mortal craft, almost the work of ghosts and spirits.
units.literal: Moreover it had stood long; Emperor Cheng did not build it— to remonstrate would miss the moment, yet silence was impossible; so he extolled and magnified it, comparing it to the Purple Palace of Heaven, as if to say no human force fashioned this— one might almost call it the work of ghosts and gods.

units.zh: 又是時趙昭儀方大幸，每上甘泉，常法從，在屬車間豹尾中。
units.en: Lady Zhao then held the emperor's favor; each visit to Sweet Springs she rode in the regulated escort among the leopard-tail guard.
units.literal: At that time the Honored Lady Zhao was in highest favor; whenever the sovereign went to Sweet Springs she rode in lawful train among the attendant cars in the leopard-tail file.

units.zh: 故雄聊盛言車騎之眾，參麗之駕，非所以感動天地，逆釐三神。
units.en: So Xiong for the moment heaped up description of chariots and paired outriders— not as means to move Heaven and earth or draw down the Three Powers.
units.literal: Therefore Xiong for the moment piled up talk of the host of chariots and the triple-paired teams— not as a way to move Heaven and earth or win blessing from the Three Powers.

units.zh: 又言「屏玉女，卻虙妃」，以微戒齋肅之事。
units.en: He also quoted the lines, "Screen the jade maid; send back Lady Fu," as a subtle admonition to keep fasting and the sacrifice solemn.
units.literal: He also said "screen the jade maid, send back Lady Fu"— a veiled hint to keep fasting and the rite solemn.

units.zh: 賦成，奏之，天子異焉。
units.en: When he submitted the piece the emperor was struck with wonder.
units.literal: When the rhapsody was finished he presented it; the Son of Heaven marveled at it.

units.zh: 其三月，將祭后土，上乃帥群臣橫大河，湊汾陰。
units.en: In the third month came the earth sacrifice; the emperor led the court across the Yellow River to Fenyin.
units.literal: In the third month they were to sacrifice to Earth; the sovereign led his ministers across the great river and gathered at Fenyin.

units.zh: 既祭，行遊介山，回安邑，顧龍門，覽鹽池，登歷觀，陟西嶽以望八荒，跡殷、周之虛，眇然以思唐、虞之風。
units.en: Afterward they toured Mount Jie, Anyi, Dragon Gate, the salt ponds, and the western peak, scanning the eight directions and pondering the vanished manners of Yao and Shun.
units.literal: After the sacrifice they toured Mount Jie, turned at Anyi, looked on Dragon Gate, viewed the salt pools, climbed the Outlook of Ages, ascended the western marchmount to scan the eight wastes, traced the ruins of Yin and Zhou, and gazed afar, thinking on the air of Tang and Yu.

units.zh: 雄以為，臨川羨魚不如歸而結網，還，上《河東賦》以勸。
units.en: Xiong judged that envying fish from the bank is not as good as going home to weave the net; on his return he presented the Hedong Rhapsody to admonish the emperor.
units.literal: Xiong thought: "Better to go home and weave the net than to envy the fish from the bank"; on return he presented the Hedong Rhapsody to urge reform.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: The text reads:
units.literal: Its words say:

units.zh: 伊年暮春，將瘞后土，禮靈祇，謁汾陰於東郊，因茲以勒崇垂鴻，發祥隤祉，飲若神明者，盛哉鑠乎，越不可載已！
units.en: In late spring they bury the earth offering at Fenyin's eastern suburb, heaping praise and praying blessing from the powers— O splendor beyond telling!
units.literal: Ah, late spring of the year— they will bury the offering to Earth, rite the spirits, pay court to Fenyin on the eastern outskirts; thereby to carve high praise and let blessing fall— drinking deep of the god's favor— how splendid, how bright— more than words can carry!

units.zh: 於是命群臣，齊法服，整靈輿，乃撫翠鳳之駕，六先景之乘，掉奔星之流旃，□天狼之威弧。
units.en: He ordered the ministers, set court dress in order, mounted the sacred car— phoenix team, six horses swifter than sunbeams, banners like meteors, bow like the star Wolf.
units.literal: Then he charged the host of ministers, aligned the ritual robes, arrayed the spirit chariot; he stroked the azure phoenix carriage, six teams that outrun the light, waved the streaming banner of shooting stars, bent the mighty bow of the celestial Wolf.

units.zh: 張耀日之玄旄，揚左纛，被雲梢。
units.en: Black plumes of the high standard rose; the left great streamer flew; cloud-pointed pennons streamed.
units.literal: They spread the sun-dark plumes of the black standard, raised the left banner-tail, draped the cloud-tipped streamers.

units.zh: 奮電鞭，驂雷輜，鳴洪鐘，建五旗。
units.en: Lightning for a whip, thunder for outriders, the great bell sounding, five banners aloft.
units.literal: They flourished the lightning whip, paired thunder as outrider, struck the great bell, raised the five flags.

units.zh: 羲和司日，顏倫奉輿，風發飆拂，神騰鬼□；
units.en: Xihe guides the day; Yanlun holds the reins; winds lash; spirits seem to race alongside.
units.literal: Xihe tends the sun, Yanlun holds the yoke; wind rises and gusts blow; spirits leap, ghosts hurry.

units.zh: 千乘霆亂，萬騎屈橋，嘻嘻旭旭，天地稠{山敖}。
units.en: Thousands of chariots thunder, myriads of riders rear; clamor fills heaven and earth.
units.literal: A thousand teams like thunder in confusion, ten thousand riders rearing; roaring laughter; heaven and earth crowd peak on peak.

units.zh: 簸丘跳巒，湧渭躍涇。
units.en: Hills tremble and ridges leap; the Wei and Jing rivers boil.
units.literal: They shake hills and leap ridges; Wei and Jing surge and leap.

units.zh: 秦神下讋，跖魂負沴；
units.en: The Qin deity cowers; wandering souls bear ill luck away.
units.literal: The god of Qin descends in awe; treading souls bear the ill-omened miasma.

units.zh: 河靈矍踢，掌華蹈衰。
units.en: The river god quakes; he treads glory and tramples decay.
units.literal: The river spirit starts and stamps; he treads splendor and tramples decline.

units.zh: 遂臻陰宮，穆穆肅肅，蹲蹲如也。
units.en: So they come to the dark shrine, grave and still, bowed in reverence.
units.literal: Thus they reach the yin palace, solemn, stern, crouching in awe.

units.zh: 靈祇既鄉，五位時敘，絪□玄黃，將紹厥後。
units.en: The powers have inclined; the five agents align; dark essence of heaven and earth will bless the heir.
units.literal: The spirits have turned; the five positions fall in order; dark vapor of black and yellow will continue the line.

units.zh: 於是靈輿安步，周流容與，以覽乎介山。
units.en: The sacred car moves at a walk, wandering at leisure, to view Mount Jie.
units.literal: Then the spirit chariot paces slowly, circling at ease, to view Mount Jie.

units.zh: 嗟文公而愍推兮，勤大禹於龍門，灑沈災於豁瀆兮，播九河於東瀕。
units.en: They sigh for Duke Wen and pity Jie Tui; they praise Yu at Dragon Gate, drown old flood sorrow in dredged channels, and spread the nine rivers toward the eastern sea.
units.literal: They sigh for Duke Wen and pity his exile; they praise Great Yu at Dragon Gate; they wash deep disaster in the opened channel; they spread the nine streams to the eastern shore.

units.zh: 登歷觀而遙望兮，聊浮游以經營。
units.en: They mount the Outlook of Ages and let the mind roam.
units.literal: They climb the Outlook of Ages and gaze afar; they float and roam in thought.

units.zh: 樂往昔之遺風兮，喜虞氏之所耕。
units.en: They savor the ancient wind; they joy in the soil Shun once tilled.
units.literal: They delight in the lingering air of old days; they rejoice in the fields Shun once plowed.

units.zh: 瞰帝唐之嵩高兮，□隆周之大寧。
units.en: They gaze upon the lofty age of Tang of Yao; they ponder the great tranquility of high Zhou.
units.literal: They gaze upon lofty Tang of Yao; they think on the great peace of exalted Zhou.

units.zh: 汨低回而不能去兮，行睨陔下與彭城。
units.en: The flood swirls; they cannot tear away; the gaze drifts to Haixia and Pengcheng.
units.literal: The current swirls; they cannot leave; their eyes slip to Haixia and Pengcheng.

units.zh: 穢南巢之坎坷兮，易豳岐之夷平。
units.en: They scorn the cruel crags of southern Nest; they prefer the gentle plain of Bin and Qi.
units.literal: They hate the jagged cruel road to southern Nest; they would trade it for the smooth ease of Bin and Qi.

units.zh: 乘翠龍而超河兮，陟西嶽之嶢崝。
units.en: On an azure dragon car they cross the river; they ascend the towering western peak.
units.literal: Riding the azure dragon they leap the river; they climb the steep western marchmount.

units.zh: 雲霏霏而來迎兮，澤滲漓而下降，郁蕭條其幽藹兮，滃泛沛以豐隆。
units.en: Clouds mass to welcome them; soft rain falls; mist gathers thick; vapor rolls immense.
units.literal: Clouds come thick to greet them; moisture drizzles down; gloom gathers in dim blue; vapor swells vast and high.

units.zh: 叱風伯於南北兮，呵雨師於西東，參天地而獨立兮，廓蕩蕩其亡雙。
units.en: They command wind and rain in the four quarters; they stand sole between heaven and earth, boundless, unmatched.
units.literal: They shout to the wind lord north and south; they call the rain master east and west; they stand alone joining heaven and earth; vast, without peer.

units.zh: 遵逝乎歸來，以函夏之大漢兮，彼曾何足與比功？
units.en: Turn homeward through the moment— within the vast Han realm, what achievement can rival this?
units.literal: Follow the passing moment home— within the great Han that embraces summer, what deeds can compare?

units.zh: 建《乾》、《坤》之貞兆兮，將悉總之以群龍。
units.en: They fix the true hexagrams of Qian and Kun; all dragons shall be gathered under them.
units.literal: They set the true omens of Qian and Kun; they will gather all under the host of dragons.

units.zh: 麗鉤芒與驂蓐收兮，服玄冥及祝觸。
units.en: Gou Mang flanks the left; Ru Shou the right; Xuan Ming and Zhu Rong draw the traces.
units.literal: They pair Gou Mang as left outrider and Ru Shou as right; they yoke Xuan Ming and Zhu Rong as team.

units.zh: 敦眾神使式道兮，奮《六經》以攄頌。
units.en: They bid the gods open the way; they wake the Six Classics to loose their song.
units.literal: They urge the host of gods to clear the road; they rouse the Six Classics to pour forth praise.

units.zh: □於穆之緝熙兮，過《清廟》之雍雍；
units.en: O that radiant peace— beyond the stately murmur of the Clear Temple hymn;
units.literal: Ah, how vast that shining peace— surpassing the solemn harmony of the Clear Temple;

units.zh: 軼五帝之遐跡兮，躡三皇之高蹤。
units.en: They overtake the Five Thearchs' distant tracks; they follow the Three Sovereigns' lofty prints.
units.literal: They pass the far traces of the Five Thearchs; they tread in the high footsteps of the Three Augusts.

units.zh: 既發軔於平盈兮，誰謂路遠而不能從？
units.en: The chariot has left the level court— who says the way is too long to ride?
units.literal: Already the shafts start from the full yard— who says the road is far and cannot be followed?

units.zh: 其十二月羽獵，雄從。
units.en: In the twelfth month the emperor held the great feather hunt; Xiong went along.
units.literal: In the twelfth month came the feathered hunt; Xiong accompanied.

units.zh: 以為昔在二帝、三王，宮館、台榭、沼池、苑囿、林麓、藪澤，財足以奉郊廟、御賓客、充庖廚而已，不奪百姓膏腴谷土桑柘之地。
units.en: Under the ancient sage-kings parks served only the suburban sacrifices, guests, and kitchens— they never seized the people's best farmland.
units.literal: He thought: of old the Two Thearchs and Three Kings kept palaces, terraces, pools, parks, groves, and marshes only large enough to supply suburban altars, entertain guests, and fill the kitchens— they did not seize the people's rich soil of grain and mulberry.

units.zh: 女有餘布，男有餘粟，國家殷富，上下交足，故甘露零其庭，醴泉流其唐，鳳皇巢其樹，黃龍游其沼，麒麟臻其囿，神爵棲其林。
units.en: Then women had extra cloth and men extra grain; the realm prospered— dew fell, springs flowed, phoenix and dragon, qilin and sacred birds appeared.
units.literal: Women had surplus cloth, men surplus grain; the state was rich, high and low alike had enough— so sweet dew fell in the courtyards, sweet springs flowed in the walks, phoenix nested in the trees, yellow dragons swam in the pools, unicorn came to the park, sacred sparrow rested in the wood.

units.zh: 昔者禹任益虞而上下和，草木茂；
units.en: When Yu put Yi in charge of the wilds, harmony reigned and vegetation flourished.
units.literal: Of old Yu employed Yi as warden of marshes and high and low were at peace; plants grew thick.

units.zh: 成湯好田而天下用足；
units.en: Tang of Shang loved hunting and still the realm wanted for nothing.
units.literal: Cheng Tang loved the hunt yet the world had enough.

units.zh: 文王囿百里，民以為尚小；
units.en: King Wen's park measured a hundred li; the people still thought it small.
units.literal: King Wen's park was a hundred li yet the people thought it still too small.

units.zh: 齊宣王囿四十里，民以為大；
units.en: King Xuan of Qi's forty-li park the people thought too large.
units.literal: King Xuan of Qi's park was forty li and the people thought it too large.

units.zh: 裕民之與奪民也。
units.en: The difference is enriching the people or robbing them.
units.literal: This is enriching the people versus stripping the people.

units.zh: 武帝廣開上林，南至宜春、鼎胡、御宿、昆吾，旁南山而西，至長楊、五柞，北繞黃山，瀕渭而東，周袤數百里，穿昆明池象滇河，營建章、鳳闕、神明、馺娑，漸台、泰液象海水周流方丈、瀛洲、蓬萊。
units.en: Emperor Wu stretched Shanglin from the southern lodges to the northern hills, dug Kunming to mirror the Dian pool, and raised Jianzhang and the tiered terraces to mimic the fairy isles in the sea.
units.literal: Emperor Wu widened Shanglin south to Yichun, Dinghu, Yusu, Kunwu, along the Southern Marchmount west to Changyang and Wuzuo, north round Yellow Mountain, hugging the Wei eastward— hundreds of li in circuit; he dug Kunming Pool to mimic the Dian river; he built Jianzhang, Phoenix Gate, Spirit Brightness, Sasuo, the Gradual Terrace and Grand Liquid to mimic the sea flowing round Fangzhang, Yingzhou, and Penglai.

units.zh: 遊觀侈靡，窮妙極麗。
units.en: Excursions grew wasteful, wonder and splendor pushed to the extreme.
units.literal: Touring sights were extravagant, subtlety and beauty pushed to the limit.

units.zh: 雖頗割其三垂以贍齊民，然至羽獵、田車、戎馬、器械、儲偫、禁御所營，尚泰奢麗誇詡，非堯、舜、成湯、文王三驅之意也。
units.en: Some outer parkland was cut back for the people, yet the hunt itself—chariots, horses, gear—still swaggered in luxury, far from the restrained three-sided chase of the sages.
units.literal: Though he somewhat carved back the three outer belts to feed the commoners, yet down to feather hunt, war chariots, mounts, gear, stores, and palisades the work remained grand and boastful— not the meaning of Yao, Shun, Cheng Tang, and King Wen's three-sided hunt.

units.zh: 又恐後世復修前好，不折中以泉台，故聊因《校獵賦》以風，其辭曰：
units.en: Lest posterity revive old excesses without the lesson of moderation, he framed the School Hunt Rhapsody as criticism. It begins:
units.literal: Fearing later ages would again pursue former excess and not hold the mean shown by the terrace of springs, he therefore used the Rhapsody on the School Hunt to remonstrate; its words say:

units.zh: 或稱戲、農，豈或帝王之彌文哉？
units.en: Some exalt Fu Xi and Shen Nong—are they the final model for emperors?
units.literal: Some praise Xi and Shen— could those be the utmost pattern of the emperors?

units.zh: 論者雲否，各亦並時而得宜，奚必同條而共貫？
units.en: Critics divide; each time suits its own measure— need all ages share one yardstick?
units.literal: Debaters say yes and no; each age fits its own use— why must all run on one rule?

units.zh: 則泰山之封，烏得七十而有二儀？
units.en: How then could Mount Tai's seventy-two forms of Feng have been one single pattern?
units.literal: Then how could the Feng sacrifice on Mount Tai yield seventy-two distinct rites?

units.zh: 是以創業垂統者俱不見其爽，遐邇五三孰知其是非？
units.en: Founders who establish a dynasty do not cling to one mold; who across the ages can fix their blame or praise?
units.literal: Therefore founders who hand down a line do not stick to one narrow gauge; across the ages who can judge their right and wrong?

units.zh: 遂作頌曰：麗哉神聖，處於玄宮，富既與地乎侔訾，貴正與天乎比崇。
units.en: He sings: "Splendid the sacred ruler in his dark hall; rich as the soil, noble as the sky."
units.literal: So he made a hymn: "Splendid the holy sage, dwelling in the dark palace; wealth matches the earth's measure, honor rivals the height of heaven."

units.zh: 齊桓曾不足使扶轂，楚嚴未足以為驂乘；
units.en: Qi's Duke Huan could scarcely steady the axle; Chu's King Zhuang not worth a seat as outrider.
units.literal: Duke Huan of Qi was hardly fit to hold the wheel-nave; King Zhuang of Chu not even to ride as outrider.

units.zh: □三王之厄薜，嶠高舉而大興；
units.en: He crosses the Three Kings' peril passes and lifts a new beginning on high;
units.literal: He passes the hard straits of the Three Kings, mounts high and raises a great beginning;

units.zh: 歷五帝之寥郭，涉三皇之登閎；
units.en: He ranges the Five Thearchs' empty vastness, passes the Three Sovereigns' lofty gates;
units.literal: He traverses the vast spaces of the Five Thearchs, crosses the high gates of the Three Augusts;

units.zh: 建道德以為師，友仁義與為朋。
units.en: He makes the Way his teacher and benevolence and right his companions.
units.literal: He takes the Way and its power as teacher, befriends benevolence and right as companions.

units.zh: 於是玄冬季月，天地隆烈，萬物權輿於內，徂落於外，帝將惟田於靈之囿，開北垠，受不周之制，以終始顓頊、玄冥之統。
units.en: In deep winter, when life hides within and dies without, the emperor will hunt the sacred park, open the north, and complete the cycle ruled by Zhuanxu and the dark god.
units.literal: Then in the dark winter month, when heaven and earth are fiercely cold, all things stir within and wither without, the emperor will hunt in the spirit park, open the northern verge, accept the rule of incompleteness, to close the line of Zhuanxu and Xuanming.

units.zh: 乃詔虞人典澤，東延昆鄰，西馳□闔。
units.en: He charges the park warden, extends the line east to Kun's border, races west to heaven's gate.
units.literal: He orders the warden of marshes to rule the marsh, extends east to Kun's neighbor, gallops west to the cosmic gate.

units.zh: 儲積共偫，戍卒夾道，斬叢棘，夷野草，御自汧、渭，經營□、鎬，章皇周流，出入日月，天與地杳。
units.en: Supplies heap up, soldiers flank the road; brush is cleared from Qian and Wei to Haojing; the work swallows sun and moon till sky and earth blur.
units.literal: Stores are piled, guards line the road; they cut brush, level wild grass; from Qian and Wei they work to Hao, wheeling round sun and moon till sky and earth merge in gloom.

units.zh: 爾乃虎路三□以為司馬，圍經百里而為殿門。
units.en: On triple tiger paths they set marshals; a hundred-li cord rings the inner gate.
units.literal: Then on tiger-skin triple lane they post marshals; a hundred li of cord marks the inner gate.

units.zh: 外則正南極海，邪界虞淵，鴻□沆茫，碣以崇山。
units.en: South to the sea, west to the twilight abyss, boundless water checked by mountains.
units.literal: Without, true south reaches the sea; slant bounds touch the sunset pool; vast flood and endless waste, dammed by towering hills.

units.zh: 營合圍會，然後先置乎白楊之南，昆明靈沼之東。
units.en: The encirclement joins; the line is first drawn south of White Poplar, east of Kunming Pool.
units.literal: The rings meet and close; then first they set the line south of White Poplar, east of Kunming's spirit pool.

units.zh: 賁、育之倫，蒙盾負羽，杖鏌邪而羅者以萬計，其餘荷垂天之畢，張竟野之罘，靡日月之誅竿，曳彗星之飛旗。
units.en: Champions like Ben and Yu, shields and plumes, Mo Ye swords—myriads; others spread heaven-wide nets and comet banners.
units.literal: Men like Ben and Yu, shield on shoulder, plume on back, wielding Mo Ye, number in the myriads; the rest hold nets that span the sky, snares that cover the wild, poles that dim sun and moon, banners like comets' tails.

units.zh: 青雲為紛，紅蜺為繯，屬之乎崑崙之虛，渙若天星之羅，浩如濤水之波，淫淫與與，前後要遮。
units.en: Rainbow rings and cloud ropes bind at Kunlun; the line glitters like stars, rolls like surf, thick before and behind.
units.literal: Azure clouds for cord, rainbow for ring; tied to Kunlun's waste, scattered like stars in the sky, vast as waves on the sea, dense and slow, front and rear blocking every gap.

units.zh: □槍為□，明月為候，熒惑司命，天弧發射，鮮扁陸離，駢衍佖路。
units.en: Comet for picket, moon for sentinel; Mars rules fate; the sky bow shoots; glittering files choke every track.
units.literal: Comet for post, bright moon for watch; Mars commands fate; the celestial bow shoots; glittering, tangled, the files crowd every path.

units.zh: 徽車輕武，鴻絧□獵，殷殷軫軫，被陵緣阪，窮冥極遠者，相與□乎高原之上；
units.en: Swift cars and light troops, silken nets, thunder up slopes; the farthest scouts mass on the plateau;
units.literal: Light cars, nimble warriors, great silken hunt-nets, rumbling, rolling, climb hills and skirt slopes; those who probe the darkest distance stand together on the high plain;

units.zh: 羽騎營營，昈分殊事，繽紛往來，□轤不絕，若光若滅者，布乎青林之下。
units.en: Cavalry hive, tasks divide, wheels hum without cease under the greenwood.
units.literal: Feathered riders swarm, duties split this way and that, shuttling back and forth, axles never ceasing— like glints now seen now gone— spread beneath the green wood.

units.zh: 於是天子乃以陽□始出乎玄宮，撞鴻鐘，建九旒，六白虎，載靈輿，蚩尤並轂，蒙公先驅。
units.en: Then the emperor, yang force leaving the dark hall, strikes the great bell, raises nine banners, six white tigers pull the sacred car, Chiyou at the hub, Meng Tian as forerunner.
units.literal: Then the Son of Heaven, as the yang force first emerges from the dark palace, strikes the great bell, raises the nine streamers, six white tigers draw the spirit car, Chiyou beside the hub, Duke Meng for vanguard.

units.zh: 立歷天之旂，曳捎星之旃，辟歷列缺，吐火施鞭。
units.en: A sky-scraping flag rises; star pennons trail; thunder cracks; lightning lashes like whips.
units.literal: He plants a banner that brushes heaven, trails star-tipped pennons; thunder cracks, lightning spits fire and lashes like whips.

units.zh: 萃傱允溶，淋離廓落，戲八鎮而開關；
units.en: The host masses, pours, spreads wide— the eight marchmounts seem to swing their gates;
units.literal: Thick throngs gather, streaming, scattered, vast— sporting with the eight guards, opening the passes;

units.zh: 飛廉、雲師，吸嗅潚率，鱗羅布列，攢以龍翰。
units.en: Wind god and rain master hurry; squadrons spread like dragon scales.
units.literal: Feilian and the cloud-master, sniffing and hasting, scale-like spread in rows, clustered like dragon plumes.

units.zh: 秋秋蹌蹌，入西園，切神光；
units.en: They sway and stride into the western park, brushing the sacred gleam;
units.literal: Qiujiu qiangqiang— they enter the western park, graze the divine light;

units.zh: 望平樂，逕竹林，蹂蕙圃，踐蘭唐。
units.en: They sight Pingle, cut through bamboo, crush orchid plots, pound thoroughwort lanes.
units.literal: They gaze on Pingle, thread the bamboo grove, trample the orchid beds, tread the thoroughwort paths.

units.zh: 舉烽烈火，轡者施披，方馳千駟，校騎萬師。
units.en: Flames leap; grooms stream pennons; a thousand four-horse teams charge, ten thousand horsemen wheel.
units.literal: Beacon fires blaze up; rein-holders spread streamers; a thousand teams gallop abreast, ten thousand riders in review.

units.zh: □虎之陳，從橫膠輵，□泣雷厲，驞□平駖磕，洶洶旭旭，天動地岋。
units.en: Tiger squadrons weave; thunder rolls; hooves hammer; the world trembles.
units.literal: Tiger formations cross and tangle; thunder weeps and cracks; hooves pound like thunder; roaring, blazing— heaven quakes, earth splits.

units.zh: 羨漫半散，蕭條數千萬里外。
units.en: The tide of riders thins and spreads to the horizon.
units.literal: The flood scatters halfway, desolate ten thousand leagues beyond.

units.zh: 若夫壯士慷慨，殊鄉別趣，東西南北，聘耆奔欲。
units.en: Bold men, fired in heart, ride every quarter, each passion loosed.
units.literal: As for stalwart men, high-hearted, each land with its own bent— east, west, south, north— they spur old desire and race their will.

units.zh: 拖蒼豨，跋犀□，蹶浮麋。
units.en: They haul blue boar, trample rhino, fell the river elk.
units.literal: They drag blue boar, stride rhinoceros, trip the floating elk.

units.zh: □巨□，捕玄□，騰空虛，距連捲。
units.en: They strike great game, seize shadowy prey, vault hollows and rolling banks.
units.literal: They strike huge beasts, seize dark quarry, leap the void, vault the curling ridge.

units.zh: □夭蟜，□澗門，莫莫紛紛，山谷為之風飆，林叢為之生塵。
units.en: They swarm the passes; valleys howl with wind, woods choke with dust.
units.literal: They bend the supple leap, crush the gorge gate; thick and thronging, valleys rise in gusts, woods lift dust.

units.zh: 及至獲夷之徒，蹶松柏，掌疾梨；
units.en: When the frontier huntsmen arrive, they trample pines and seize wild pears as they pass;
units.literal: When the Huo-yi huntsmen come, they trample pine and cypress and grasp wild pear;

units.zh: 獵蒙蘢，轔輕飛；
units.en: They tear through thickets, crush birds on the wing;
units.literal: They hunt the thick scrub, crush the light-winged;

units.zh: 履般首，帶修蛇；
units.en: They tread serpent heads, belt great snakes;
units.literal: They tread python heads, gird long snakes;

units.zh: 鉤赤豹，牽象犀；
units.en: They leash red leopard, drag elephant and rhino;
units.literal: They hook red leopards, lead elephant and rhino;

units.zh: □巒坑，超唐陂。
units.en: They vault steep pits, ford the Tang pools.
units.literal: They leap sunken pits, cross Tang marsh.

units.zh: 車騎雲會，登降暗藹，泰華為旒，熊耳為綴。
units.en: Hosts mass like clouds; Taihua serves as banner, Bear-Ear as pendant.
units.literal: Chariots and riders cloud together, mounting and descending in dim blue— Mount Taihua for streamer, Bear-Ear for pendant.

units.zh: 木僕山還，漫若天外，儲與乎大溥，聊浪乎宇內。
units.en: Forest and hill fall away until the hunt seems lost beyond heaven, roaming the boundless world.
units.literal: Trees fall, hills wheel back, vague as beyond the sky; stored vastness in the great expanse, roaming at ease within the world.

units.zh: 於是天清日晏。
units.en: Then the sky clears and noon sun softens.
units.literal: Then sky clears and the sun is mild.

units.zh: 逢蒙列訾，羿氏控弦，皇車幽輵，光純天地，望舒彌轡，翼乎徐至於上蘭。
units.en: Peng Meng arrays the targets, Yi's line bends the bow; the royal car glows; the moon-charioteer checks rein until they reach Shanglan.
units.literal: Peng Meng ranks the sights, Yi clan bends the bow; the imperial car is dim and deep, its light fills heaven and earth; Moon-driver checks the reins, winging slowly up to Shanglan.

units.zh: 移圍徙陳，浸淫蹴部，曲隊堅重，各按行伍。
units.en: The cordon slides, companies wade deep; curved ranks lock, each file in place.
units.literal: They shift the ring, move the lines, soak and trample the ranks; curved squadrons stand firm, each holds its file.

units.zh: 壁壘天旋，神手失電擊，逢之則碎，近之則破，鳥不及飛，獸不得過，軍驚師駭，刮野掃地。
units.en: The wall of hunters wheels; lightning strikes— bird and beast are sealed; armies reel as the plain is swept clean.
units.literal: Ramparts wheel with heaven; spirit hands strike like lightning— touch them and they shatter, near them and they burst; birds cannot fly, beasts cannot pass; hosts panic, masters start; they scrape the wild bare as a floor.

units.zh: 乃至□車飛揚，武騎聿皇；
units.en: Light cars leap, armored riders charge;
units.literal: Till light cars soar, martial riders wheel;

units.zh: 蹈飛豹，絹嘄陽；
units.en: They tread the flying leopard, net the roaring beast;
units.literal: They trample flying leopard, rope the roaring yang;

units.zh: 追天寶，出一方；
units.en: They pursue the prize, erupt from one flank;
units.literal: They chase heaven's treasure, burst from one quarter;

units.zh: 應駍聲，擊流光。
units.en: Hooves answer thunder; blows chase the glint.
units.literal: They answer the hoof's thunder, strike the streaming light.

units.zh: 野盡山窮，囊括其雌雄，沈沈容容，遙噱乎□中。
units.en: Hill and plain are emptied; buck and doe are bagged; laughter rolls through the hollow.
units.literal: Wild ends, hills exhaust; bagging buck and doe, deep and wide, they laugh afar in the void.

units.zh: 三軍芒然，窮□閼與，但觀夫票禽之紲□，犀□之抵觸，熊羆之□攫，虎豹之凌遽，徒角搶題注，□戚竦讋怖，魂亡魄失，觸輻關脰。
units.en: The army halts, stunned in the defile— only watching bound game, horned beasts goring, bears and tigers leaping; brutes lock horns; men stare witless, throats against the axle.
units.literal: The three armies stand dazed, blocked in narrow passes— only watching the tethered swift prey, rhinos goring, bears and griffins snatching, tigers and leopards pouncing; horns butt, heads ram, eyes glare; terror strikes soul from body, neck meets wheel.

units.zh: 妄發期中，進退履獲，創淫輪夷，丘累陵聚。
units.en: Shafts strike home; advance and retreat trample the slain; the slain pile ridge on ridge.
units.literal: Random shots hit the mark; advance and retreat tread capture; wounded lie in wheel-ruts, corpses heap like hills.

units.zh: 於是禽殫中衰，相與集於靖冥之館，以臨珍池。
units.en: When the kill flags, they gather at the Quiet-dark hall above the jeweled pool.
units.literal: Then game is spent halfway; together they gather at the Lodge of Still Darkness, overlooking the jeweled pool.

units.zh: 灌以岐梁，溢以江河，東瞰目盡，西暢亡崖，隨珠和氏，□爍其陂。
units.en: Streams from Qi and Liang feed it; east the view ends, west has no bank— pearls gleam on its banks.
units.literal: They pour in the waters of Qi and Liang, overflow with Yangzi and Yellow River; eastward the eye reaches its limit, westward no shore— Sui pearls and He jade flash on its slopes.

units.zh: 玉石□，炫耀青熒，漢女水潛，怪物暗冥，不可殫形。
units.en: Jade glints green in the depths; divers and dim shapes move— forms past counting.
units.literal: Jade and stone gleam, green firelight; Han girls dive in the deep; monsters lurk in darkness— shapes beyond telling.

units.zh: 玄鸞孔雀，翡翠垂榮，王雎關關，鴻雁嚶嚶，群□乎其中，□□昆鳴；
units.en: Peacock and simurgh, kingfisher in splendor; ospreys and geese call; flocks clamor within the reed beds.
units.literal: Dark simurgh and peacock, kingfisher trailing glory; fishhawks cry, wild geese call; flocks dart among them, calling in chorus;

units.zh: 鳧鷖振鷺，上下砰磕，聲若雷霆。
units.en: Wildfowl beat wings up and down; the noise is thunder.
units.literal: Ducks and herons, egrets up and down, clash like thunder.

units.zh: 乃使文身之技，水格鱗蟲，凌堅冰，犯嚴淵，探巖排□，薄索蛟螭，蹈猵獺，據黿鼉，□靈□。
units.en: Tattooed swimmers seize dragons in icy deeps, rake caves for horned serpents, tread otters, grapple turtles and crocodiles.
units.literal: Then tattooed divers grapple scaled creatures, tread hard ice, brave the bitter deep, probe cliffs, part caves, hunt jiao-dragons, tread otters, seize giant turtles and alligators, and grasp the numinous tortoise.

units.zh: 入洞穴，出蒼梧，乘巨鱗，騎京魚。
units.en: They dive caverns, surface at Cangwu, ride leviathans of the deep.
units.literal: They enter caverns, emerge at Cangwu, ride giant fish, mount whale.

units.zh: 浮彭蠡，目有虞，方椎夜光之流離，剖明月之珠胎，鞭洛水之虙妃，餉屈原與彭胥。
units.en: They float across Lake Pengli and gaze toward Youyu; they hammer night-shining crystal, split the wombs of moon-bright pearls, whip Lady Fu of the Luo, and offer a feast to Qu Yuan, Peng Xian, and Wu Zixu.
units.literal: They float on Lake Pengli and gaze toward Youyu; they hammer night-shining crystal, split the wombs of moon-bright pearls, whip Lady Fu of the Luo, and offer a feast to Qu Yuan, Peng Xian, and Wu Zixu.

units.zh: 於茲乎鴻生巨儒，俄軒冕，雜衣裳，修唐典，匡《雅》、《頌》，揖讓於前。
units.en: Then great ru in court dress, revising Tang models and the Odes, bow in ritual before him.
units.literal: Then great scholars and huge Confucians, tall in caps and sashes, mixed robes, revise Tang canons, correct Ya and Song, bow and yield before the throne.

units.zh: 昭光振耀，蠁□如神，仁聲惠於北狄，武義動於南鄰。
units.en: Radiance streams like gods; humane fame reaches the Di; martial awe shakes the south.
units.literal: Glory flashes and dazzles; they move like spirits; humane sound spreads to northern Di, martial awe stirs the southern neighbor.

units.zh: 是以旃裘之王，胡貉之長，移珍來享，抗手稱臣。
units.en: So kings in felt cloaks and Hu chieftains bring tribute, raise their hands, and declare themselves subjects.
units.literal: Therefore felt-cape kings and Hu chieftains move treasures to offer fealty, raise hands and call themselves servants.

units.zh: 前入圍口，後陳盧山。
units.en: They enter the hunt's mouth in front, with Mount Lu massed behind.
units.literal: They enter the ring mouth in front, range Mount Lu behind.

units.zh: 群公常伯楊硃、墨翟之徒喟然稱曰：「崇哉乎德，雖有唐、虞、大廈、成周之隆，何以侈茲！
units.en: The assembled lords and ministers, Yang Zhu, Mozi, and their like, sighed and said, "How lofty is this virtue! Though Yao and Shun had their glory, and though the Great Hall of Xia and flourishing Zhou rose so high, how could they surpass this!
units.literal: The assembled lords and regular ministers, Yang Zhu, Mozi, and the like, sighed and exclaimed, "How lofty is this virtue! Though Yao and Shun had their glory, and though the Great Hall of Xia and flourishing Zhou reached such heights, how could they exceed this!

units.zh: 太古之覲東嶽，禪梁基，捨此世也，其誰與哉？」
units.en: In high antiquity one revered the eastern marchmount and performed the feng and shan at Mount Tai and Liang— apart from this age, who could equal it?"
units.literal: In high antiquity one paid homage at the eastern marchmount and performed the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai and Liang— apart from this age, who could match it?"

units.zh: 上猶謙讓而未俞也，方將上獵三靈之流，下決醴泉之滋，發黃龍之穴，窺鳳皇之巢，臨麒麟之囿，幸神雀之林；
units.en: The emperor still refused self-praise: he would trace the Three Lights above, tap sweet springs below, open the dragon's den, seek phoenix nest and qilin park—
units.literal: The sovereign still demurred, not yet consenting— he would hunt upward the courses of the Three Luminaries, downward open the sweet springs' flow, send forth the yellow dragon's cave, peer into the phoenix nest, visit the qilin park, favor the sacred sparrow grove;

units.zh: 奢雲夢，侈孟諸，非章華，是靈台，罕徂離宮而輟觀游，土事不飾，木功不雕，承民乎農桑，勸之以弗迨，儕男女使莫違；
units.en: reject vain parks like Yunmeng, prefer the Spirit Terrace, spare detached palaces, leave timber plain, bind the people to plow and weave, and keep households in moral order;
units.literal: reject Yunmeng's excess, Mengzhu's waste; not Zhanghua but the Spirit Terrace; seldom visit detached palaces or halt pleasure tours; earth works unadorned, wood craft uncarved; uphold the people in farming and silk, urge them not to lag, set men and women in order that none stray;

units.zh: 恐貧窮者不遍被洋溢之饒，開禁苑，散公儲，創道德之囿，弘仁惠之虞，馳弋乎神明之囿，覽觀乎群臣之有亡；
units.en: fear the poor miss the surplus— open the imperial preserve, empty granaries for them, fence a park of virtue, widen mercy, hunt only where ritual allows, scan ministers' want or plenty;
units.literal: fearing the poor might not share overflowing bounty— open the forbidden park, scatter public stores, create a park of the Way, widen the preserve of kindness, shoot only in the grove of the gods, survey whether ministers have or lack;

units.zh: 放雉菟，收□罘，麋鹿芻蕘與百姓共之，蓋所以臻茲也。
units.en: turn hares free, furl nets, share deer and brushwood with the people— that is how to reach true perfection.
units.literal: release pheasants and hares, gather up the nets, let deer and fuel grass be shared with the hundred surnames— such is the way to reach this end.

units.zh: 於是醇洪□之德，豐茂世之規，加勞三皇，勖勤五帝，不亦至乎！
units.en: Then virtue runs deep and wide, the age's pattern grows rich— outdoing the Three Augusts and Five Thearchs in care for the people!
units.literal: Then pure and vast is the virtue, rich the model for the age— adding toil to the Three Augusts, urging effort on the Five Thearchs— could anything be higher!

units.zh: 乃祗莊雍穆之徒，立君臣之節，崇賢聖之業，未皇苑囿之麗，遊獵之靡也，因回軫還衡，背阿房，反未央。
units.en: So the grave ministers fix ruler and subject, honor the sages' task, and set no store by park splendor or hunting show— the car turns home from Epang to Weiyang.
units.literal: Then the solemn, reverent throng sets the bond of lord and minister, exalts the work of worthies and sages— they have no leisure for garden beauty or hunt extravagance; so they wheel the chariot, turn the yoke, leave Epang, return to Weiyang.

units.zh: 又神農、桐君論《本草》藥性，黃帝、岐伯說病候治方，皆聖人之所重也。
units.en: Shennong and Lord Tong classified herbs in the Root Canon; the Yellow Emperor and Qibo set forth disease and cure—all arts the sages held dear.
units.literal: Again, Shennong and Lord Tong discussed the properties of drugs in the Root Canon of Materia Medica; the Yellow Emperor and Qibo explained symptoms and healing prescriptions—all were prized by sages.

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 譬若以周、邵為丞相，孔丘為御史大夫，太公為將軍，畢公高拾遺於後，弁嚴子為衛尉，皋陶為大理，後稷為司農，伊尹為少府，子贛使外國，顏、閔為博士，子夏為太常，益為右扶風，季路為執金吾，契為鴻臚，龍逢為宗正，伯夷為京兆，管仲為馮翊，魯般為將作，仲山甫為光祿，申伯為太僕，延陵季子為水衡，百里奚為典屬國，柳下惠為大長秋，史魚為司直，蘧伯玉為太傅，孔父為詹事，孫叔敖為諸侯相，子產為郡守，王慶忌為期門，夏育為鼎官，羿為旄頭，宋萬為式道候。」
units.en: Imagine the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao as your chancellors; Confucius as chief censor; the Grand Duke as commander; Duke Bi Gao as court remonstrant; Bian Zhuangzi as captain of the guard; Gao Yao as chief judge; Hou Ji as minister of agriculture; Yi Yin as palace treasurer; Zigong as foreign envoy; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian as court scholars; Zixia as master of rites; Yi as western capital intendant; Zilu as capital commandant; Xie as master of guest ceremonies; Guan Longpeng as keeper of the imperial genealogy; the minister Boyi as metropolitan governor; Guan Zhong as northern capital intendant; Lu Ban as chief engineer; Zhong Shanfu as palace chamberlain; the Earl of Shen as master of the horse; Prince Jizi of Yanling as keeper of parks and waters; Baili Xi as commissioner for dependent peoples; Liuxia Hui as chamberlain to the empress; Shi Yu as censor of conduct; Qu Boyu as grand tutor; Kong Fu as supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao as chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan as commandery governor; Prince Qingji as a palace gate guard; Xia Yu as cauldron officer; Yi the Archer as vanguard officer; and Song Wan as road-clearing scout."
units.literal: It is as if you had made the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao your chancellors; Confucius your Censor-in-Chief; the Grand Duke your general; Duke Bi Gao your remonstrant at the rear; Bian Zhuangzi your Commandant of the Guards; Gao Yao your Chief Justice; Hou Ji your Minister of Agriculture; Yi Yin your Privy Treasurer; Zigong your envoy abroad; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian your Erudites; Zixia your Minister of Ceremonies; Yi your western capital intendant; Zilu your Capital Commandant; Xie your Grand Herald; Guan Longpeng your Director of the Imperial Clan; the minister Boyi your Metropolitan Governor; Guan Zhong your northern capital intendant; Lu Ban your Superintendent of Works; Zhong Shanfu your Chamberlain for Attendants; the Earl of Shen your Grand Coachman; Prince Jizi of Yanling your Superintendent of Waters and Parks; Baili Xi your Director of Dependent States; Liuxia Hui your Chamberlain for the Empress; Shi Yu your Rectifier; Qu Boyu your Grand Tutor; Kong Fu your supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao your chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan your commandery governor; Prince Qingji your Palace Gate Guard; Xia Yu your Cauldron Officer; Yi the Archer your Vanguard Officer; and Song Wan your road-clearing scout."

units.zh: 伏願陛下哀忠念舊，愛孤恤寡，矜愚嘉善，舍過記功，敦骨肉之情，廣寬仁之路，思堯、舜之風，慕禹、湯之德，克己復禮，以成美化，天下幸甚。」
units.en: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
units.literal: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual, to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

units.zh: 駙馬都尉置由漢武，[9]或以假諸功臣，或以加於戚屬，是以魏曹植表駙馬、奉車趣為一號。
units.en: The consort commandant was created by Han Wudi; [9] it was sometimes given to meritorious ministers and sometimes to kin—hence Cao Zhi in Wei asked to merge consort commandant and carriage attendant into one title.
units.literal: The post of Commandant of the Consort's Carriage was established by Emperor Wu of Han; [9] sometimes it was lent to meritorious ministers, sometimes added for kin—hence in Wei, Cao Zhi petitioned to make the consort commandant and the carriage attendant a single title.
