units.zh: 駙馬都尉置由漢武 「由」字原本漫漶，今據各本補。
units.en: On "consort commandant established by Han Wudi": the character you was faded in the base text and is restored from other editions.
units.literal: The post of Commandant of the Consort's Carriage was established by Emperor Wu of Han—the character "by" in the original was effaced; it is now supplied from the various editions.

units.zh: 昔漢氏西京，梁王建國，平臺東苑，慕義如林，馬卿辭武騎之官，枚乘罷弘農之守。
units.en: In former times, at the Western Capital of Han and when Liang founded its state, the Level Terrace and Eastern Park drew men of virtue like a forest; Sima Xiangru resigned his post in the Feathered Cavalry, and Mei Sheng gave up his governorship of Hongnong.
units.literal: In former times the Western Capital of Han and the founding of Liang's state, the Level Terrace and Eastern Park drew men of virtue like a forest; Sima Xiangru resigned his post in the Feathered Cavalry, Mei Sheng gave up his governorship of Hongnong.

units.en: Carving wood and cutting paper has no precedent—how could Ban and Mo's inventiveness be surpassed?"
units.literal: Carving wood and cutting paper—there is no precedent for that; how could the thought of Ban and Mo be surpassed?"

units.en: “As for women like Qingqin and Fufei, they were set apart from the ordinary world: alluring, elegant, composed, and richly adorned, nimble and [lacuna] graceful, soft, yielding, [lacuna], charming, delicate, slender, and frail. They trailed garments of single-cocoon [lacuna], faint and slender, moving with easy grace, their dress unlike that of the common world. Their fragrance was dense and luxuriant, their scent intense and lovely; their white teeth shone, their smiles glittered, their long brows curved finely, and their slight glances drifted into the distance. Their beauty seized the soul, and the heart rejoiced beside them.”

units.zh: 好讀《太玄經》，註揚雄《蜀都賦》。
units.en: He loved to read the Classic of Supreme Mystery and annotated Yang Xiong's Rhapsody on the Capital of Shu.
units.literal: He loved to read the Classic of Supreme Mystery and annotated Yang Xiong's Rhapsody on the Capital of Shu.

units.zh: 每云：「我欲與揚子雲周旋。」
units.en: He would often say, "I wish to keep company with Yang Ziyun."
units.literal: He would often say, "I wish to keep company with Yang Ziyun."

units.zh: 己卯，分遣大使宣勞四方，下璽書敕州郡曰：「夫四王革代，商、周所以應天，五勝相推，軒、羲所以當運。
units.en: On jimao day he sent great envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters, issuing sealed letters of instruction to the provinces and commanderies: "The four kings changed the age—Shang and Zhou thus answered Heaven; the Five Agents succeeded one another—Xuanyuan and Fuxi thus met their destined turn.
units.literal: On jimao day he dispatched great envoys to proclaim comfort to the four quarters and sent down imperial-seal letters instructing the provinces and commanderies, saying: "The four kings changed the age—Shang and Zhou thereby answered Heaven; the Five Victories succeeded one another—Xuan and Xi thereby met their fortune.

units.zh: 周道衰，法度颦，至齊桓公任用管仲，而國富民安。
units.en: As Zhou order eroded, Qi's reform under Guan Zhong restored wealth and stability.
units.literal: When Zhou declined and norms wrinkled, Duke Huan of Qi employed Guan Zhong, and the state became wealthy and the people secure.

units.zh: 至乎齊桓、晉文之兵，可謂入其域而有節制矣，然猶未本仁義之統也。
units.en: Huan and Wen improved discipline but still fell short of a fully benevolent-just political foundation.
units.literal: As for the armies of Duke Huan of Qi and Duke Wen of Jin, they may be said to have entered their domain with restraint, yet still did not root in the unifying principle of benevolence and righteousness.

units.zh: 故齊之技擊不可以遇魏之武卒，魏之武卒不可以直秦之銳士，秦之銳士不可以當桓、文之節制，桓、文之節制不可以敵湯、武之仁義。」
units.en: Thus Qi's skilled fighters cannot match Wei's trained soldiers; Wei's trained soldiers cannot stand against Qin's elite warriors; Qin's elite warriors cannot withstand the discipline of Duke Huan and Duke Wen; and the discipline of Huan and Wen cannot rival the benevolence and righteousness of Tang and Wu.'
units.literal: Thus Qi's technical fighters cannot meet Wei's martial graduates; Wei's martial graduates cannot directly face Qin's elites; Qin's elites cannot withstand Huan and Wen's disciplined system; Huan and Wen's discipline cannot rival Tang and Wu's benevolence and righteousness.'

units.zh: 齊桓南服彊楚，使貢周室，北伐山戎，為燕開路，存亡繼絕，功為伯首，所謂善戰不敗者也。
units.en: Huan's record shows effective campaigning and interstate stabilization without strategic defeat.
units.literal: Duke Huan of Qi subdued powerful Chu in the south, made it tribute to Zhou court, campaigned north against mountain Rong and opened routes for Yan, preserving fallen states and continuing severed lines, becoming foremost hegemon-this is what is meant by one good at fighting not losing.

units.zh: 公問行伯用師之道，管仲曰：「公欲定卒伍，修甲兵，大國亦將修之，而小國設備，則難以速得志矣。」
units.en: The duke asked about the way to pursue hegemony through military force. Guan Zhong said: 'If Your Grace wishes to organize the ranks and prepare armor and weapons, the great states will also prepare theirs, and the small states will set up defenses. Then it will be hard to achieve your aim quickly.'
units.literal: The duke asked about hegemony by military means. Guan Zhong said: 'If Your Grace wishes to fix ranks and repair armor and weapons, great states will also repair theirs, and small states will ready defenses, so quick success will be hard.'

units.zh: 老子曰：「其政察察，其人缺缺。」
units.en: Laozi said, "When government is excessively exacting, the people grow impoverished in spirit."
units.literal: Laozi said: "When government is minutely scrutinizing, the people are deficient and incomplete."

units.zh: 又曰：「法令滋章，盜賊多有。」
units.en: He also said, "When laws and statutes proliferate, thieves and bandits multiply."
units.literal: He also said: "When laws and decrees multiply, robbers and bandits abound."

units.zh: 成帝初，清河都尉馮逡奏言：「郡承河下流，與兗州東郡分水為界，城郭所居尤卑下，土壤輕脆易傷。
units.en: Early in Emperor Cheng's reign, Qinghe commandant Feng Jun reported: "Our commandery lies in the downstream path and shares watershed boundaries with Yan and Dong. Our settlements are particularly low, with friable soils that are easily damaged.
units.literal: At the start of Emperor Cheng's reign, Qinghe commandant Feng Jun memorialized: "Our commandery receives downstream river flow, sharing water boundaries with Yan and Dong commanderies; our city sites are especially low, and soil is light and fragile, easily damaged.

units.zh: 簡文夜夢吞一塊土，意甚不悅，以告不害，不害曰：「昔晉文公出奔，野人遺之塊，卒反晉國，陛下此夢，事符是乎？」
units.en: Emperor Jianwen one night dreamed he swallowed a clod of earth and was very displeased. He told Buhai, and Buhai said, "In old times Duke Wen of Jin went into exile; a rustic gave him a clod, and in the end he returned to Jin. Your Majesty's dream—does the matter match this?"
units.literal: Emperor Jianwen one night dreamed he swallowed a clod of earth and was very displeased. He told Buhai, and Buhai said: "In old times Duke Wen of Jin went into exile; a rustic gave him a clod, and in the end he returned to Jin. Your Majesty's dream—does the matter match this?"

units.zh: 放勛、重華之世，咸無意於受終，當塗、典午之君，雖有心於揖讓，皆以英才處萬乘，高勳御四海，故能大庇黔首，光宅區縣。
units.en: Yao and Shun took the throne without seeking it; the rulers of Wei and Jin, though they spoke of abdication, still set men of rare talent upon the throne and men of towering merit at the helm of the realm—thus they sheltered the people and brought order to the land.
units.literal: In the ages of Fangxun and Chonghua, both were without intent to receive the end; the lords of Dangtu and Dianwu, though they had mind for yielding, all alike placed men of outstanding talent upon the ten-thousand chariots, with high merit steering the four seas—therefore they could greatly shelter the black-haired people and brightly settle the districts and counties.

units.zh: 既而煙雲表色，日月呈瑞，緯聚東井，龍見譙邦，除舊布新，既彰玄象，遷虞事夏，且協謳訟，[2]九域八荒，同布衷款，百神群祀，皆有誠願。
units.en: Then clouds and mist took auspicious hues; sun and moon showed signs; stars clustered at the Eastern Well; a dragon was seen in Qiao. The old order gave way to the new, and Heaven's signs were plain; as in the transfer from Shun to Yu, the people's acclaim agreed. [2] Within the nine provinces and beyond the eight directions, loyal petitions poured in; every spirit and rite was offered in earnest devotion.
units.literal: Thereafter clouds and mist showed color; sun and moon presented omens; constellations gathered at the Eastern Well; a dragon appeared in the Qiao region. Removing the old and spreading the new, the dark signs were already manifest; shifting from Yu and serving Xia, and moreover matching the songs of praise, [2] the nine domains and eight wilds alike spread forth sincere petitions; the hundred spirits and assembled sacrifices all had sincere wish.

units.zh: 梁氏以天祿斯改，期運永終，欽若唐、虞，推其鼎玉，朕東西退讓，拜手陳辭，避舜子於箕山之陽，求支伯於滄洲之野，而公卿敦逼，率土翹惶，天命難稽，遂享嘉祚。
units.en: The House of Liang, its mandate spent, its turn complete—like Tang and Yu they offered up the regalia. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and pleaded our case, hiding like Shun's son on Mount Ji's sunny slope, seeking Zhibo on Cangzhou's wilds—but ministers pressed us and the realm looked up in dread. Heaven's mandate would not wait; thus We received the glorious throne.
units.literal: The House of Liang, its heavenly blessing now changed, its allotted span ended forever—reverently in accord with Tang and Yu, they pushed forth their tripod and jade. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and spoke our plea, avoiding Shun's son on the sunny slope of Mount Ji, seeking Zhibo on the wilds of Cangzhou—but the dukes and ministers pressed urgently; the whole land looked up in alarm. Heaven's mandate could not be delayed; thus We received the fine fortune.

units.zh: 臣等竊以音之所起，出自人心，夔、曠不能長存，人事不能常泰，人亡則音息，世亂則樂崩，若不深知禮樂之情，安能明制作之本。
units.en: We hold that music arises from the human heart; masters like Kui and Kuang cannot endure forever, and human affairs cannot always prosper—when men die, music falls silent; when the age is chaotic, music collapses. Without deep understanding of ritual and music, how can one grasp the foundations of cultural order?
units.literal: We your servants consider privately that where sound arises, it comes from the human heart; Kui and Kuang cannot long endure, human affairs cannot always be peaceful; when men perish sound ceases, when the age is chaotic music collapses—if one does not deeply know the sentiments of ritual and music, how can one clarify the root of establishment and regulation?

units.zh: 夫以四子之行，屈平之材，然猶不能自顯而被刑戮，豈不足以觀哉！
units.en: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!
units.literal: For men of such conduct and Qu Yuan's talent still could not display themselves and met execution—does it not suffice for reflection!

units.zh: 樞肆志尋覽，殆將周遍，乃喟然歎曰：「吾聞貴爵位者以巢、由為桎梏，愛山林者以伊、呂為管庫，束名實則芻芥柱下之言，翫清虛則糠秕席上之說，稽之篤論，亦各從其好也。
units.en: Shu read through them almost entirely and sighed: "I hear that men who prize office take Chao Fu and Xu You as shackles, and men who love the hills take Yi and Lü as storekeepers; those who bind name to fact treat Laozi as straw, and those who play at emptiness treat banquet talk as chaff. In earnest judgment each follows his own bent.
units.literal: Shu with full intent searched and read them, nearly covering all; he then sighed and said: "I have heard that those who prize rank and title take Chao Fu and Xu You as fetters, and those who love mountains and forests take Yi and Lü as granary keepers; binding name and reality makes Laozi's words mere hay; playing with emptiness and purity makes seat-side doctrines mere chaff; checked against earnest discourse, each also follows his own preference.

units.zh: 顓頊帝高陽氏
units.en: Emperor Zhuanxu Gaoyang
units.literal: Zhuanxu Emperor, the Gaoyang clan

units.zh: 伏聞朝議以高祖大造區夏，道侔姬文，提記明堂，式配上帝。
units.en: We hear the court argues that because the High Ancestor shaped the realm within the four seas and his Way matched King Wen of Zhou, he raised the Bright Hall to sacrifice to the Lord on High.
units.literal: We have heard that court discussion, because the High Ancestor greatly fashioned the realm within the four seas and his Way matched King Wen of Zhou, raised the record of the Bright Hall to match the Lord on High.

units.zh: 對曰：「數尋伊、霍之傳，不讀曹、馬之書。」
units.en: He replied, "I pore over the lives of Yi Yin and Huo Guang — not the chronicles of Cao Cao and the Sima clan."
units.literal: He replied: "I often seek the biographies of Yi Yin and Huo Guang; I do not read the books of Cao [Cao] and the Sima [clan]."

units.zh: 元坦 元斌 元孝友 元暉業 元弼 元韶
units.en: Yuan Tan; Yuan Bin; Yuan Xiaoyou; Yuan Huiye; Yuan Bi; Yuan Shao
units.literal: Yuan Tan; Yuan Bin; Yuan Xiaoyou; Yuan Huiye; Yuan Bi; Yuan Shao

units.zh: 昔般庚去奢，行俭于亳；
units.en: Long ago Pan Geng forsook luxury and embraced austerity when he ruled from Bo.
units.literal: In antiquity Pan Geng cast off extravagance and practiced economy at Bo.

units.zh: 仲山父異姓之臣，無親於宣，就封於齊，猶歎息永懷，宿夜徘徊，不忍遠去，況將軍之於主上，主上之與將軍哉！
units.en: Zhong Shanfu, no kin to King Xuan, still lingered in sorrow when posted to Qi—how much more should you, bound to the emperor by blood and office?
units.literal: Zhong Shanfu was a minister of different surname, without closeness to Xuan, yet when he went to his fief in Qi still sighed long thoughts, lodged night wandering, could not bear to go far—how much more the general toward the lord above, the lord above toward the general!

units.zh: 跡三代之季世，覽宗、宣之饗國，察近屬之符驗，禍敗曷常不由女德？
units.en: Trace the last generations of the Three Dynasties, consider how long Gaozong of Shang and King Xuan of Zhou enjoyed their realms, and examine the signs confirmed among more recent kin: when did disaster and ruin not turn on the conduct of women?
units.literal: Trace the final generations of the Three Dynasties, consider Gaozong and King Xuan's long possession of their realms, and examine the signs confirmed among more recent kin: when did disaster and ruin not arise from the conduct of women?
